title_en: Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur Opens With 268 Suites And Record Pricing
title_zh: 吉隆坡华尔道夫酒店 (Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur) 开业，设有 268 间套房，价格创纪录
summary: The Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur has opened with 268 all-suite rooms and record-setting rates for the city. It looks gorgeous, but I'm not sure the pricing makes sense.
summary_zh: 吉隆坡华尔道夫酒店 (Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur) 开业，拥有 268 间全套房客房，创下了该市的房价记录。看起来很漂亮，但不知道效果如何
body_en: The Waldorf Astoria brand has been on an impressive growth trajectory in recent times, and has opened several new flagship properties. This Hilton luxury brand has just opened its latest hotel , in Kuala Lumpur. It looks beautiful, but I can’t help but wonder if it will succeed. Let me explain…
268-key, all-suite Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur opens

The Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur has opened as of late October 2026. The residential-style, all-suite property features 268 accommodations, ranging in size from 80 square meters (861 square feet) to 745 square meters (8,019 square feet).
The property is set within Kuala Lumpur’s “Golden Triangle” district, and as you’d expect, it’s intended to be an urban retreat with both extensive dining and wellness facilities.

Dining options are headlined by Jean-Georges Vongerichten’s signature market-to-table concepts at JG KL, abc kitchens KL, and The Bar by JG. Then there’s also The Istana (where breakfast is served), Yaari (serving Indian cuisine), and Peacock Alley (the signature Waldorf Astoria bar concept).
The Waldorf Astoria Spa is 2,275 square meters (24,488 square feet), and features La Prairie treatments. Then there’s a fitness center, along with an outdoor pool.
Based on the renderings that have been shared so far, the property looks beautiful, in my opinion.
This is Kuala Lumpur’s most expensive hotel, by far

Kuala Lumpur is one of my favorite hotel markets in the world, in terms of how reasonably priced luxury hotels are, at least by international standards (of course I understand that doesn’t factor in local buying power). The city’s current top hotels, like the Four Seasons and Park Hyatt, can be had for around $300 per night.

With that in mind, what are rates like at the Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur? Well, the hotel is trying to set a new pricing record in the city, and not just by a small margin. I see the absolute lowest rate currently being $479 per night, though seasonally rates are $600+. That’s before taxes and fees, for a base suite.

If you’re booking a cash rate, I’d recommend doing so through the Hilton for Luxury program , which offers extra perks when booking through select travel advisors, including breakfast, a hotel credit, an upgrade subject to availability, and more.

For those redeeming Hilton Honors points , the rate seems to be 100,000 points per night, assuming a standard suite is available. At my valuation of 0.5 cents per Hilton point, that’s like “paying” $500 per night to stay here, inclusive of taxes and fees.

When you consider that standard suites are over 860 square feet, that price probably doesn’t seem unreasonable. You’re getting more than twice the space you’d ordinarily get at the city’s top luxury hotels, so it’s not illogical that the pricing would be higher.

If this hotel had 60 accommodations, I’d say there’s probably a market for that, by just chasing the very top end of consumers who value space. But 268 accommodations?! That’s an absolutely massive number of suites to fill at record prices. I mean, this hotel will have more keys than the Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur.

I just can’t imagine the hotel will be able to run any sort of decent occupancy with that pricing, and so many suites to fill. Either I’m wrong, or the hotel will have to lower prices, or will consistently run low occupancy.

The other thing is that if you’re not specifically looking for a suite, it’s really hard to compete with the Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur , which is also new, and a really stellar property . It also creates intrigue among people, given that it’s one of the world’s highest up hotels .

The Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur is now open. The 268-suite property is setting new records in the city, both for entry level room size, and also for pricing. The property looks beautiful, and the dining options also look top notch. However, filling 268 rooms at rates that are 50%+ higher than any existing option will be a challenge.
What do you make of the Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur? Do you think they’ll be able to get these rates while running decent occupancy?
body_zh: 华尔道夫品牌近年来一直处于令人印象深刻的增长轨迹，并开设了几家新的旗舰酒店。这个希尔顿豪华品牌刚刚在吉隆坡开设了最新的酒店。它看起来很漂亮，但我忍不住想知道它是否会成功。让我解释一下……
拥有 268 间客房的全套房吉隆坡华尔道夫酒店开业
吉隆坡华尔道夫酒店已于 2026 年 10 月下旬开业。这家住宅风格的全套房酒店拥有 268 间客房，面积从 80 平方米（861 平方英尺）到 745 平方米（8,019 平方英尺）不等。
该酒店位于吉隆坡的“金三角”区，正如您所期望的那样，它旨在成为一个拥有丰富餐饮和健康设施的城市度假胜地。
JG KL、abc kitchens KL 和 The Bar by JG 的餐饮选择以 Jean-Georges Vongerichten 的标志性“从市场到餐桌”概念为特色。此外，还有 The Istana（供应早餐）、Yaari（供应印度美食）和 Peacock Alley（华尔道夫酒店标志性酒吧概念）。
华尔道夫水疗中心占地 2,275 平方米（24,488 平方英尺），提供 La Prairie 理疗服务。另设健身中心和室外泳池。
根据迄今为止分享的效果图，在我看来，该房产看起来很漂亮。
这是迄今为止吉隆坡最昂贵的酒店
吉隆坡是我最喜欢的世界酒店市场之一，就豪华酒店的价格合理而言，至少按照国际标准来看（当然我知道这不考虑当地的购买力）。该市目前的顶级酒店，如四季酒店和柏悦酒店，每晚只需 300 美元左右。
考虑到这一点，吉隆坡华尔道夫酒店的房价是多少？嗯，这家酒店正试图在该市创下新的定价记录，而且不仅仅是以很小的幅度。我发现目前的绝对最低价格为每晚 479 美元，但季节性价格为 600 美元以上。这是基本套房的税费前的价格。
如果您以现金预订，我建议您通过希尔顿豪华计划进行预订，该计划在通过精选旅行顾问预订时提供额外福利，包括早餐、酒店积分、视供应情况而定的升级等等。
对于那些兑换希尔顿荣誉客会积分的人来说，假设有标准套房，价格似乎是每晚 100,000 点积分。按照我对每希尔顿积分 0.5 美分的估价，这相当于每晚“支付”500 美元住在这里，包括税费。
当您考虑到标准套房的面积超过 860 平方英尺时，这个价格可能看起来并不是不合理。您获得的空间是该市顶级豪华酒店通常的两倍以上，因此定价更高并非不合逻辑。
如果这家酒店有 60 间客房，我想说可能有市场，只要追逐重视空间的最高端消费者即可。但268间住宿？！这绝对是数量巨大的套房，需要以创纪录的价格入住。我的意思是，这家酒店的钥匙比吉隆坡柏悦酒店还要多。
我只是无法想象这家酒店能够以这样的价格提供任何体面的入住率，而且还有这么多的套房需要入住。要么我错了，要么酒店将不得不降低价格，或者持续保持低入住率。
另一件事是，如果你不是专门寻找套房，那么它真的很难与吉隆坡柏悦酒店竞争，因为它也是新的，而且是一家非常出色的酒店。鉴于它是世界上最高的酒店之一，它也引起了人们的兴趣。
吉隆坡华尔道夫酒店现已开业。这家拥有 268 间套房的酒店无论是入门级房间面积还是定价都创下了该市的新纪录。酒店看起来很漂亮，餐饮选择也看起来是一流的。然而，以比任何现有选项高出 50% 以上的价格入住 268 间客房将是一项挑战。
您如何看待吉隆坡华尔道夫酒店？您认为他们能够在保持良好的入住率的同时获得这些价格吗？

title_en: We Tracked The World's First Boeing 747-8 Freighter For A Week: Here's Where It Went
title_zh: 我们追踪世界上第一架波音 747-8 货机一周：它去了哪里
summary: The aircraft is operated by Cargolux.
summary_zh: 该飞机由 Cargolux 运营。
body_en: Journalist - Steven has a varied background in communications, and it was this passion for writing combined with his in-depth knowledge of the aviation industry that led him to Simple Flying. A keen linguist, he also has experience in translation and interpreting. Based in Palma, Spain

The Boeing 747-8F remains one of the most capable cargo aircraft in commercial aviation, combining enormous payload capacity with the range required to connect major freight markets. Among the aircraft still operating, Cargolux's LX-VCB holds a special place in aviation history as the first 747-8F delivered by Boeing .
Tracking its movements between October 19 and 25 reveals how a single aircraft supports a global logistics network spanning Asia, the Middle East, North America, and Europe.

Using the Simple Flying Flight Tracker , the aircraft's movements can be followed leg by leg, revealing a demanding schedule of long-haul flights and intermediate stops. The week also coincided with a serious landing gear incident involving sister aircraft LX-VCF, which prompted inspections across the 747-8F fleet. Together, these developments highlight the complexity of international air freight and the continuing importance of Boeing's largest production freighter.

LX-VCB began its tracked week on October 19, operating Cargolux Flight CV342 from Miami International Airport (MIA) to Luxembourg Airport (LUX). It departed at 7:21 am UTC and arrived at 3:26 pm UTC, completing the transatlantic journey in eight hours and five minutes. That evening, it departed again, demonstrating how quickly a dedicated freighter can return to service after a long flight.

Its next assignment was CV9001, which left Luxembourg at 7:49 pm UTC for Astana Nursultan Nazarbayev International Airport (NQZ) in Kazakhstan. The aircraft arrived at 02:05 UTC on October 20 after six hours and 16 minutes, connecting Europe with Central Asia. LX-VCB did not remain in Astana for long.

Flight CV9001 continued to Taipei Taoyuan International Airport (TPE), departing at 5:37 am UTC and arriving at 12:38 pm UTC after seven hours and one minute. Retaining the flight number across successive legs illustrates how cargo services can operate as connected journeys rather than isolated city pairs.

Later that day, LX-VCB departed Taipei for Singapore Changi Airport (SIN) as CV9022, arriving at 7:17 pm UTC after four hours in the air. Within two days, the aircraft had crossed several major cargo markets, demonstrating the international reach of the Boeing 747-8F and its ability to transport substantial freight volumes between regions.
A Diversion In Muscat Before The Return To Asia

On October 21, LX-VCB departed Singapore at 9:43 pm UTC on CV9022, a service bound for Luxembourg that diverted to Muscat International Airport (MCT) in Oman. It arrived at 04:06 UTC after six hours and 22 minutes. The tracking data establishes the diversion but does not establish its cause, making speculation about the circumstances inappropriate without confirmation from Cargolux.

The aircraft subsequently continued from Muscat to Luxembourg, operating as CLX1G rather than retaining the CV9022 flight number. It departed at 5:57 am UTC and arrived at 1:21 pm UTC, completing the journey in seven hours and 24 minutes. The changed designation illustrates how operational adjustments can affect the flight numbers recorded for individual segments.

After returning to Luxembourg, LX-VCB departed at 7:17 pm UTC on CV4793, bound for Hong Kong International Airport (HKG). It arrived at 7:06 am UTC on October 22 after an 11-hour-and-49-minute flight. The schedule carried it from Singapore through Muscat and Luxembourg before sending it back east, reflecting the interconnected nature of international cargo operations.

Cargolux's network is built around Luxembourg, with dedicated freighters connecting markets across multiple continents. The Muscat stop remains a documented part of LX-VCB's movements, but its reason remains unconfirmed - tracking data reveals where the aircraft went, not necessarily why its original plan changed.

The next sequence began on October 22, when LX-VCB departed Hong Kong at 9:41 am UTC on CV287. It arrived at Ted Stevens Anchorage International Airport (ANC) at 6:23 pm UTC after eight hours and 43 minutes. Positioned between Asia and North America, Anchorage is a natural stopping point for cargo aircraft crossing the North Pacific.

LX-VCB departed Anchorage at 7:44 pm UTC, continuing on the same CV287 service to Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW). It arrived at 1:30 am UTC on October 23 after five hours and 46 minutes. Keeping the same flight number across both segments shows that the aircraft was following a broader sequence of cargo destinations rather than simply connecting two endpoints.

From Dallas/Fort Worth, the aircraft continued to Miami, departing at 4:49 am UTC and arriving at 6:57 am UTC. The domestic leg lasted two hours and eight minutes. Three consecutive destinations under CV287 connected Hong Kong with Anchorage, Dallas/Fort Worth, and Miami, illustrating how a freighter can serve several markets during one extended operation. LX-VCB then departed Miami for Luxembourg at 9:20 am UTC on October 23, arriving at 5:19 pm UTC after seven hours and 59 minutes, completing the loop.
Emergency squawks, holds, NOTAMs — unique signals, live, no signup.

Passenger airlines often organize schedules around recognizable return journeys, while dedicated freighters frequently operate more complicated patterns because freight demand varies by destination, shipment type, and time of day. An aircraft may deliver part of its load at one airport, collect additional cargo elsewhere, and continue to another destination before returning home.

The CV287 sequence demonstrates this principle. Rather than flying directly from Hong Kong to Luxembourg, LX-VCB crossed the Pacific to Anchorage, continued to Dallas/Fort Worth and Miami, and eventually returned to Luxembourg. The flight number remained associated with successive legs, illustrating how one scheduled service can encompass several stages of a wider cargo operation.
body_zh: 记者 - 史蒂文在传播领域拥有不同的背景，正是这种对写作的热情与他对航空业的深入了解相结合，促使他创立了《简单飞行》。作为一位敏锐的语言学家，他还拥有翻译和口译经验。总部位于西班牙帕尔马
波音 747-8F 仍然是商业航空中能力最强的货机之一，将巨大的有效载荷能力与连接主要货运市场所需的航程相结合。在仍在运营的飞机中，Cargolux 的 LX-VCB 作为波音交付的第一架 747-8F 在航空史上占有特殊的地位。
追踪其 10 月 19 日至 25 日期间的活动，揭示了单架飞机如何支持横跨亚洲、中东、北美和欧洲的全球物流网络。
使用简单飞行跟踪器，可以逐条跟踪飞机的运动，揭示长途飞行和中途停留的严格时间表。本周还发生了涉及姊妹机 LX-VCF 的严重起落架事故，这促使对 747-8F 机队进行了检查。总之，这些发展凸显了国际航空货运的复杂性以及波音最大的生产货机的持续重要性。
LX-VCB 于 10 月 19 日开始其跟踪周，运营从迈阿密国际机场 (MIA) 飞往卢森堡机场 (LUX) 的 Cargolux 航班 CV342。它于世界标准时间上午 7:21 出发，于下午 3:26 抵达（世界标准时间），在 8 小时 5 分钟内完成了跨大西洋旅程。当天晚上，它再次出发，展示了一艘专用货机在长途飞行后恢复服务的速度有多快。
它的下一个任务是 CV9001，于世界标准时间晚上 7:49 离开卢森堡前往哈萨克斯坦阿斯塔纳努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫国际机场 (NQZ)。这架飞机在 6 小时 16 分钟后于 10 月 20 日世界标准时间 02:05 抵达，连接欧洲和中亚。 LX-VCB 并没有在阿斯塔纳停留太久。
CV9001 航班继续飞往台北桃园国际机场 (TPE)，于世界标准时间凌晨 5:37 起飞，并于 7 小时 1 分钟后于中午 12:38 抵达。保留连续航段的航班号说明了货运服务如何作为相互连接的旅程而不是孤立的城市对进行运营。
当天晚些时候，LX-VCB 航班号 CV9022 从台北出发飞往新加坡樟宜机场 (SIN)，在飞行四个小时后于晚上 7 点 17 分抵达世界标准时间 (UTC)。两天之内，这架飞机飞越了几个主要货运市场，展示了波音 747-8F 的国际影响力及其在地区之间运输大量货运量的能力。
返回亚洲之前在马斯喀特的改道
10 月 21 日，LX-VCB 于世界标准时间晚上 9:43 搭乘 CV9022 号航班从新加坡出发，该航班开往卢森堡，后转飞阿曼马斯喀特国际机场 (MCT)。六小时 22 分钟后，于世界标准时间 04:06 抵达。跟踪数据确定了转移，但没有确定其原因，因此在没有得到卢森堡货运航空公司确认的情况下，对情况的猜测是不恰当的。
该飞机随后继续从马斯喀特飞往卢森堡，航班号为 CLX1G，而不是保留 CV9022 航班号。航班于世界标准时间凌晨 5:57 出发，于下午 1:21 抵达（世界标准时间），全程用时 7 小时 24 分钟。更改后的名称说明了运营调整如何影响各个航段记录的航班号。
返回卢森堡后，LX-VCB 于世界标准时间晚上 7:17 搭乘 CV4793 出发，前往香港国际机场 (HKG)。经过 11 小时 49 分钟的飞行后，飞机于 10 月 22 日上午 7 点 06 分（世界标准时间）抵达。该航班从新加坡出发，途经马斯喀特和卢森堡，然后返回东部，这反映了国际货运业务的相互关联性。
Cargolux 的网络围绕卢森堡建立，拥有连接多个大陆市场的专用货机。马斯喀特停留仍然是 LX-VCB 行动的记录部分，但其原因仍未得到证实 - 跟踪数据揭示了飞机的去向，但不一定是其最初计划改变的原因。
下一个序列于 10 月 22 日开始，当时 LX-VCB 于世界标准时间上午 9:41 乘坐 CV287 从香港出发。经过 8 小时 43 分钟后，飞机于世界标准时间下午 6 点 23 分抵达特德·史蒂文斯安克雷奇国际机场 (ANC)。安克雷奇位于亚洲和北美之间，是货机穿越北太平洋的天然停靠点。
LX-VCB 于世界标准时间晚上 7:44 从安克雷奇出发，继续搭乘同一趟 CV287 航班前往达拉斯/沃斯堡国际机场 (DFW)。经过 5 小时 46 分钟后，飞机于 10 月 23 日凌晨 1 点 30 分（世界标准时间）抵达。两个航段保持相同的航班号表明飞机遵循更广泛的货运目的地顺序，而不是简单地连接两个端点。

飞机从达拉斯/沃斯堡继续飞往迈阿密，于世界标准时间凌晨 4:49 起飞，并于世界标准时间上午 6:57 抵达。国内赛段持续了两个小时零八分钟。 CV287 的三个连续目的地将香港与安克雷奇、达拉斯/沃斯堡和迈阿密连接起来，展示了一艘货机如何在一次扩展运营中服务于多个市场。 LX-VCB 随后于 10 月 23 日上午 9:20（世界标准时间）从迈阿密出发前往卢森堡，并在 7 小时 59 分钟后于下午 5:19 到达世界标准时间，完成了环路。
紧急尖叫、等待、航行通告 - 独特的信号，实时，无需注册。
客运航空公司通常围绕可识别的回程航班安排航班时刻表，而专用货机则经常运营更复杂的模式，因为货运需求因目的地、货运类型和一天中的时间而异。一架飞机可以在一个机场运送部分货物，在其他地方收集额外的货物，然后在返回之前继续飞往另一个目的地。
CV287 序列证明了这一原理。 LX-VCB 没有从香港直接飞往卢森堡，而是跨越太平洋飞往安克雷奇，继续飞往达拉斯/沃斯堡和迈阿密，最终返回卢森堡。航班号仍然与连续的航段相关联，说明一项定期航班如何涵盖更广泛的货运业务的多个阶段。

title_en: Lufthansa Crew Member Dies Of Electrocution In Hotel Swimming Pool During Layover
title_zh: 汉莎航空机组成员中途停留期间在酒店游泳池触电身亡
summary: A late evening incident at Conrad Bengaluru's third floor pool involving Lufthansa crew and a visiting executive has prompted a full police probe.
summary_zh: 深夜，班加罗尔康莱德酒店三楼泳池发生一起涉及汉莎航空机组人员和一名来访高管的事件，警方已展开全面调查。
body_en: Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

A swim in the pool at the Conrad Bengaluru has left one Lufthansa crew member dead and another foreign national deceased, after it was alleged that both died due to electrocution at the hotel's swimming pool. The incident, which occurred on the evening of Friday, October 30, involved a Lufthansa crew member who was in the city for a layover after operating one of the airline's nonstop flights to India .

The Conrad Bengaluru, which is part of the Hilton chain, is a five-star hotel located in the central business district of Bengaluru. Both victims have been identified, and they are German Alexander Maximilian Theiss, a crew member for Lufthansa, and the other person was Juraj Horvat, a Slovakian national who was in the city on business for tech giant IBM.

Lufthansa Crew Member Killed After Swimming At The Conrad Bengaluru

A police complaint filed by the German national's wife, Silvia Ottawa, said Theiss died while trying to exit the Conrad's picturesque third-story pool. At this point, it remains unclear what the exact cause of the incident was, and as reported by NDTV , the alleged electrocution has not been confirmed by authorities.

Lufthansa crew member Theiss was in Bengaluru after crewing on a Lufthansa flight to Kempegowda International Airport Bengaluru (BLR). Lufthansa operates to Bengaluru with nonstop flights from both Frankfurt Airport (FRA) and Munich Airport (MUC).
The Conrad Hotel released a statement that they were saddened by the incident and are continuing to work with local police

"We are deeply saddened by the tragic incident which occurred at Conrad Bengaluru yesterday which led to the subsequent passing away of two guests. We offer our deepest condolences to all those impacted. The cause of the incident has not yet been established and remains subject to a comprehensive investigation by local authorities. We are offering our full support to their investigation. Our team remains available to provide all appropriate assistance to relevant authorities as their investigation continues."
Simple Flying reached out to Lufthansa for comment on the incident; however, an airline spokesperson could not immediately be reached.
Two Others Injured And Were Transported To Hospital

Four individuals were injured in the pool incident and were transported to Manipal Hospital. Theiss is confirmed to have arrived at the hospital with severe injuries and was pronounced dead on arrival . Horvat was being administered CPR on arrival; however, despite all efforts, he was unable to be saved.

Matthew Desantis, a US national who was staying at the hotel on Friday night, and Rahul Tiwari, an Indian national who was the pool attendant, sustained injuries while attempting to rescue the victims. Both the US national and the Indian pool attendant underwent treatment for non-life-threatening injuries and will be discharged.
The Conrad Bengaluru has closed the swimming pool while the investigation is ongoing, with the hotel's website stating it is 'closed for maintenance' until the end of November.
body_zh: 记者 – Aaron 是一名航空和旅行记者，在旅行和旅游业拥有 14 年的经验。他的背景涵盖机场运营、航空基础设施和旅游咨询，曾与新西兰、欧洲和北美的全球组织合作。
Aaron 将行业专业知识与五大洲超过 52 个国家/地区的第一手旅行经验相结合，涵盖航空公司、机场、航空政策和更广泛的旅行领域。他居住在新西兰坎特伯雷。
他的作品发表在《Simple Flying》上，并受到 MSN、SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel、EIN News、Pakistan Defence 和 Climate Depot 的专题报道。
在班加罗尔康莱德酒店的游泳池中游泳，导致一名汉莎航空机组人员死亡，另一名外国人死亡，据称两人均因在酒店游泳池触电身亡。这起事件发生在 10 月 30 日星期五晚上，涉及一名汉莎航空机组人员，该机组人员在执飞该航空公司飞往印度的直飞航班后，在该市中途停留。
班加罗尔康莱德酒店隶属于希尔顿连锁酒店，是一家位于班加罗尔中央商务区的五星级酒店。两名遇难者的身份均已确定，他们是德国汉莎航空机组人员亚历山大·马克西米利安·泰斯（Alexander Maximilian Theiss），另一人是斯洛伐克国民尤拉吉·霍瓦特（Juraj Horvat），他在该市为科技巨头 IBM 出差。
查看今天这条航线上的每个航班，包括实时高度、速度和延误情况。
地图上的每架汉莎航空航班均实时显示延误、改道和等待时间。
在这个故事中，机场的实时到达、出发、等待和复飞。
追踪天空最有趣的时刻，直播
等待、改航和稀有飞机，一目了然。免费，无需注册。
汉莎航空机组人员在班加罗尔康莱德酒店游泳后身亡
德国公民的妻子西尔维娅·渥太华向警方提交的投诉称，泰斯在试图离开康拉德酒店风景如画的三楼游泳池时死亡。目前，尚不清楚事件的具体原因是什么，据NDTV报道，所谓的触电事件尚未得到当局证实。
汉莎航空机组人员泰斯在搭乘汉莎航空飞往班加罗尔肯佩高达国际机场 (BLR) 的航班后抵达班加罗尔。汉莎航空运营着从法兰克福机场 (FRA) 和慕尼黑机场 (MUC) 飞往班加罗尔的直达航班。
康莱德酒店发表声明称，他们对这一事件感到悲痛，并正在继续与当地警方合作
“我们对班加罗尔康莱德酒店昨天发生的悲惨事件深感悲痛，该事件导致两名客人去世。我们向所有受影响的人表示最深切的哀悼。事件原因尚未确定，仍有待地方当局进行全面调查。我们将全力支持他们的调查。随着调查的继续，我们的团队将随时为有关当局提供一切适当的协助。”
Simple Flying 联系汉莎航空寻求对这一事件的评论；不过，无法立即联系到航空公司发言人。
另两人受伤，被送往医院
四人在泳池事件中受伤，被送往马尼帕尔医院。泰斯被证实已被送往医院，伤势严重，并在抵达后被宣布死亡。霍瓦特抵达后正在接受心肺复苏术；然而，尽管尽了一切努力，他还是没能获救。
周五晚上入住该酒店的美国公民马修·德桑蒂斯(Matthew Desantis)和泳池服务员、印度公民拉胡尔·蒂瓦里(Rahul Tiwari)在试图营救受害者时受伤。美国国民和印度泳池服务员都接受了治疗，没有生命危险，并将出院。
班加罗尔康拉德酒店已关闭游泳池，调查仍在进行中，酒店网站称游泳池“因维护而关闭”，直至 11 月底。

title_en: 10 Airlines Offering Stopover Packages For A Fraction Of The Cost Of A Separate Trip
title_zh: 10 家航空公司提供中途停留套餐，费用仅为单独旅行的一小部分
summary: Discover 10 airlines offering affordable stopovers, from free hotel stays in China and Istanbul to Iceland adventures and Qatar's $14 hotel packages.
summary_zh: 了解 10 家提供实惠中途停留的航空公司，从中国和伊斯坦布尔的免费酒店住宿到冰岛探险之旅和卡塔尔的 14 美元酒店套餐。
body_en: 10 Airlines Offering Stopover Packages For A Fraction Of The Cost Of A Separate Trip

Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

Airline stopover programs give travelers an opportunity to explore an additional destination without necessarily paying for a separate flight. Instead of spending hours in an airport waiting for a connection , passengers can turn their layover into a mini-vacation and discover another country's culture, cuisine, and attractions along the way. Some airlines even offer complimentary hotel stays or discounted rates, making these detours far more affordable than planning an independent trip.

The following list follows a geographical progression, starting in China and Southeast Asia, then moving through the Middle East to Europe. It covers 10 airline stopover and transit initiatives , ranging from free hotel accommodation for eligible connecting passengers to extended stopovers that do not require an additional airfare charge. Conditions vary considerably, however, and travelers should check the linked official program terms before booking, as hotel availability, ticket eligibility, and additional expenses can affect the overall value.
Long connections more comfortable and interesting

China's major airlines offer several transit accommodation schemes that can help eligible passengers avoid paying for an overnight hotel during a connecting journey. For example, Air China offers qualifying passengers one night's hotel accommodation, breakfast, and airport transfers where available in selected cities, including Beijing, Chengdu, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Tianjin, and Wenzhou. Air China's official transit accommodation policy explains the service and its conditions.

China Southern Airlines also offers free transit accommodation to eligible passengers, while China Eastern Airlines operates an overnight transit hotel service that passengers can apply for through its website. These programs are especially useful for travelers with lengthy connections at major Chinese hubs, though eligibility depends on the airline's rules and the booked itinerary.

The principal advantage is avoiding the cost of an overnight stay while traveling through China. However, these offers are primarily designed for transit passengers rather than for unrestricted multi-day holidays. Travelers should check China Southern's website and China Eastern's transit hotel application page to confirm availability, connection requirements, and whether their tickets qualify.
Discover more of Malaysia without planning a separate international trip
Credit: HU Art and Photography | Shutterstock

Malaysia Airlines' Bonus Side Trip program gives eligible international passengers an opportunity to add another destination to their journey. Instead of buying a separate flight, travelers may be able to add another Malaysian destination to their itinerary, depending on available routes and the program's conditions. The initiative encourages visitors to explore more of Malaysia while traveling through the airline's network.

The country offers plenty of possibilities for an additional stop. Passengers might combine a visit to Kuala Lumpur, with its Petronas Twin Towers and bustling food markets, with another destination offering historic architecture, tropical scenery, or coastal attractions. For international visitors, this can offer a more varied holiday without the planning required for an entirely separate trip.

Check the precise benefits and eligible destinations before booking, as the program's conditions determine which passengers and itineraries qualify. Travelers should not assume every side trip is free or that every ticket covers every route. More information is available through the airline's official Bonus Side Trip page.

Passengers connecting through Singapore can use their layover to discover one of Asia's most recognizable cityscapes without paying for a separate guided sightseeing excursion. Singapore Airlines and Changi Airport Group are associated with the Free Singapore Tour, which gives eligible transit passengers an introduction to the city during their connecting journey. The tours provide a convenient alternative to spending the entire layover inside the terminal .

The guided tours last about 2.5 hours and cover themes such as heritage, cultural attractions, the Singapore River, and the Marina Bay area. Travelers generally need a 5.5- to 24-hour connection to qualify, and participation depends on tour schedules, seat availability, and applicable entry requirements.

Unlike a conventional stopover package, this initiative does not provide a hotel stay or several days in the destination. Nevertheless, it offers a particularly convenient way to see Singapore's highlights, including its waterfront skyline and historic districts, during a journey that would otherwise involve waiting at Singapore Changi Airport (SIN). Travelers can consult the official Free Singapore Tour page for current eligibility requirements and tour arrangements.
A complimentary stay can make a connection more attractive

Etihad Airways offers eligible passengers a hotel-based stopover in Abu Dhabi International Airport (AUH), letting travelers explore the United Arab Emirates’ capital. The airline advertises complimentary accommodation for up to two nights in selected three- and four-star hotels, subject to its booking conditions. Passengers can turn a connecting journey into a short city break without paying the standard room rate.

Abu Dhabi offers attractions ranging from the impressive Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque to Louvre Abu Dhabi Museum and the presidential palace at Qasr Al Watan. A two-night stay gives travelers time to experience several of the city's cultural highlights while adding another destination to their international journey. It can be particularly appealing to passengers who would otherwise have to pay for accommodation during an extended connection.

The free hotel offer is subject to eligibility requirements, including the relevant Etihad itinerary and available accommodation. Passengers must check the applicable entry requirements and booking conditions. Travelers seeking a longer visit may also find discounted accommodation options, depending on availability.
body_zh: 10 家航空公司提供中途停留套餐，费用仅为单独旅行的一小部分
经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。
航空公司中途停留计划让旅客有机会探索其他目的地，而无需支付单独的航班费用。乘客不必在机场花费数小时等待转机，而是可以将中转停留变成一个迷你假期，并沿途探索另一个国家的文化、美食和景点。一些航空公司甚至提供免费酒店住宿或折扣价格，使这些绕道旅行比计划独立旅行更实惠。
以下列表按照地理顺序排列，从中国和东南亚开始，然后穿过中东到达欧洲。它涵盖了 10 项航空公司中途停留和过境举措，从为符合条件的转机乘客提供免费酒店住宿到无需额外支付机票费用的延长中途停留。然而，情况差异很大，旅客应在预订前查看链接的官方计划条款，因为酒店供应情况、门票资格和额外费用可能会影响整体价值。
长连接更舒适有趣
中国的主要航空公司提供多种中转住宿计划，可以帮助符合条件的乘客避免在转机旅程中支付过夜酒店费用。例如，国航在北京、成都、上海、杭州、天津和温州等特定城市为符合条件的乘客提供一晚酒店住宿、早餐和机场接送服务。国航官方中转住宿政策对该服务及其条件进行了解释。
中国南方航空还为符合条件的旅客提供免费中转住宿，而中国东方航空则提供隔夜中转酒店服务，旅客可以通过其网站申请。这些计划对于在中国主要枢纽进行长途转机的旅客特别有用，但资格取决于航空公司的规则和预订的行程。
主要优点是避免在中国旅行时过夜的费用。然而，这些优惠主要是为过境旅客设计的，而不是为不受限制的多日假期设计的。旅客应查看南航网站和东航中转酒店申请页面，确认空房情况、转机要求以及机票是否符合条件。
无需计划单独的国际旅行，即可探索更多马来西亚
图片来源：HU 艺术与摄影 | Shutterstock
马来西亚航空的额外旅程计划为符合条件的国际乘客提供了在旅程中添加另一个目的地的机会。旅客可以根据可用航线和计划条件，将另一个马来西亚目的地添加到其行程中，而不是购买单独的航班。该计划鼓励游客在通过航空公司网络旅行时探索更多马来西亚。
这个国家提供了很多额外停留的可能性。乘客可以将参观吉隆坡及其双子塔和热闹的食品市场与另一个拥有历史建筑、热带风光或沿海景点的目的地结合起来。对于国际游客来说，这可以提供更加多样化的假期，而无需计划完全单独的旅行。
预订前请检查具体的优惠和符合条件的目的地，因为该计划的条件决定了哪些乘客和行程符合资格。旅行者不应假设每次支线旅行都是免费的，或者每张票都涵盖每条路线。更多信息可通过航空公司的官方“额外旅程”页面获取。
通过新加坡转机的乘客可以利用中转时间探索亚洲最知名的城市景观之一，而无需支付单独的导游观光游览费用。新加坡航空和樟宜机场集团合作推出“免费新加坡之旅”，为符合资格的过境乘客在转机旅程中介绍这座城市。这些旅游提供了一种便捷的选择，让您无需在航站楼内度过整个中转时间。
导览游持续约 2.5 小时，涵盖遗产、文化景点、新加坡河和滨海湾地区等主题。旅客通常需要 5.5 至 24 小时的转机才能获得资格，参与情况取决于旅游时间表、座位供应情况和适用的入场要求。
与传统的中途停留套餐不同，该计划不提供酒店住宿或目的地几天的服务。尽管如此，它提供了一种特别便捷的方式来观赏新加坡的亮点，包括其海滨天际线和历史街区，而无需在新加坡樟宜机场 (SIN) 等待。旅客可以查阅新加坡免费旅游官方页面，了解当前的资格要求和旅游安排。
免费住宿可以让转机更有吸引力
阿提哈德航空为符合条件的旅客提供在阿布扎比国际机场 (AUH) 停留酒店的服务，让旅客探索阿拉伯联合酋长国的首都。该航空公司宣传在选定的三星级和四星级酒店提供最多两晚的免费住宿，具体取决于其预订条件。乘客无需支付标准房价即可将转机旅程变成短暂的城市休息。
阿布扎比拥有众多景点，从令人印象深刻的谢赫扎耶德大清真寺到阿布扎比卢浮宫博物馆和 Qasr Al Watan 的总统府。两晚的住宿让旅客有时间体验这座城市的多个文化景点，同时为他们的国际旅程增添另一个目的地。对于在长途转机期间必须支付住宿费的乘客来说，这尤其有吸引力。
免费酒店优惠须符合资格要求，包括相关的阿提哈德行程和可用住宿。乘客必须检查适用的入境要求和预订条件。寻求长期旅行的旅客还可以找到打折的住宿选择，具体取决于供应情况。

title_en: How Many Crew Members Does It Take To Fly A C-5 Galaxy?
title_zh: 驾驶 C-5 Galaxy 需要多少名机组人员？
summary: The C-5 Galaxy is one of the world's largest military transport aircraft, but its crew requirements reveal a challenge that goes beyond its huge size.
summary_zh: C-5 Galaxy 是世界上最大的军用运输机之一，但它的机组人员需求揭示了一个超出其巨大尺寸的挑战。
body_en: Passionate about promoting aviation, the beauty of flight and the science behind it, Antonio is an avid reader of aviation magazines and books, and he loves visiting airshows all over the world, taking photos and writing about airplanes and helicopters as well. He is currently based in Palermo, Sicily.

The Lockheed C-5M Super Galaxy can take off weighing 840,000 lb (381,024 kg), yet the United States Air Force's standard crew consists of just seven people. In January 2020, however, one aircraft left Dover Air Force Base (DOV) with twelve crew members and spent fifteen days away. The difference is more than a matter of numbers: it raises a question about what it takes to operate one of the world's largest military transport aircraft.

So why did that flight need five additional people? The answer involves the C-5M's crew structure, the demands of a long-distance mission, and decisions made before the aircraft even leaves the ground. Understanding the difference also helps explain why the Air Force has retained a larger crew for the Galaxy than for the smaller C-17 Globemaster III.

According to the Air Mobility Command fact sheet , the C-5M’s standard crew is a pilot , a co-pilot, two flight engineers and three loadmasters. Airman Magazine independently lists the same breakdown, and Air & Space Forces Magazine agrees. The pilots fly the aircraft, while the other five handle systems monitoring and cargo operations. Their responsibilities help explain why the C-5M needs a larger crew than some newer military transports.

The aircraft they operate is anything but ordinary. As reported by the same fact sheet, the cargo compartment runs 143 feet, 9 inches (43.8 meters) long, 19 feet (5.79 meters) wide, and 13 feet, 6 inches (4.11 meters) high, with 36 pallet positions and a maximum payload of 281,001 lb (127,460 kg). Four engines , each rated at 51,250 pounds (228 kN)of thrust, push it along at 518 miles per hour (833.5 km/h). Aerial refueling can extend the aircraft's range, although crew endurance remains a limiting factor on long missions. Even without refueling, a C-5M carrying 281,001 lb can fly 2,150 nautical miles (3,982 km), unload, and continue another 500 nautical miles (926 km) to a second base. That kind of operation requires coordination between the flight crew and the loadmasters. Right now, the Air Force owns 52 of these aircraft, spread across four bases, and each one needs the same seven roles filled.
Three of the seven crew members are loadmasters, making them the largest group in the standard crew. So what do three loadmasters actually do once the engines are running?

The loadmasters' responsibilities begin before takeoff and continue throughout the mission. According to a Joint Base San Antonio-Lackland (JBSA) training profile , loadmasters handle loading and offloading, pre-flight and post-flight checks of aircraft systems, weight-and-balance calculations, airdrops, and the decision about how much cargo and how many passengers go where. On a C-5M, that job is physical and mathematical at the same time.

The C-5M's design gives loadmasters several ways to handle oversized cargo. Its nose can swing upward while the rear ramp is lowered, allowing loading operations at both ends of the aircraft. Full-width drive-on ramps also accommodate double rows of vehicles, according to Air Mobility Command. Air & Space Forces Magazine lists loads such as two M1 Abrams tanks, six Boeing AH-64 Apache helicopters or seven MRAP vehicles. The landing gear can even kneel, lowering the floor so tall cargo is easier to roll aboard. Every one of those loads has to be placed so the aircraft stays balanced, which is why the schoolhouse starts with math. An instructor there put it bluntly: fail that portion and you are out.

With the cargo secured, the other two non-pilot positions in the standard crew become the focus: the flight engineers. Their role has largely disappeared from modern airline cockpits, but the C-5M still relies on them to monitor the aircraft's systems.
Why The C-5 Galaxy Still Needs Two Flight Engineers

The C-5's cockpit reflects the era in which the aircraft was designed. When the Galaxy was developed in the 1960s, large aircraft commonly carried dedicated flight engineers to monitor systems and assist the pilots. As Simple Flying explains , the Galaxy was conceived in the 1960s, long before glass cockpits existed, and its mission did not justify digital avionics until much later in its service life. The same JBSA profile says flight engineers handle preflight, through-flight, and post-flight inspections away from home station, and work out engine fuel consumption from airspeed and atmospheric data.

Modernization has changed what flight engineers work with, but it has not eliminated the role. Airman Magazine notes that upgrades brought flat-panel displays, new navigation and safety equipment, and a new autopilot. Air Mobility Command also says a diagnostic system now records data from more than 7,000 test points. The flight engineers remain responsible for monitoring the aircraft's systems, while further flight deck display upgrades are still in development, according to Air & Space Forces Magazine. We will see exactly how the flight engineer earns that seat, on a mission that went wrong, in a moment.

The C-17’s fact sheet shows just 3 crew members. Its smaller crew reduces manpower requirements, risk exposure and long-term costs. The C-5M's standard crew is more than twice as large, but a January 2020 mission departed with twelve people on board. If three people can run a big airlifter, why did one C-5M mission launch with twelve?
Emergency squawks, holds, NOTAMs — live signals, no signup.
Why A C-5 Galaxy Flew With 12 Crew Members In 2020

Seven is the standard crew complement, not a limit on how many people can be assigned to a mission. As reported by Air Mobility Command , the REACH 190 left Dover on January 13, 2020, counted twelve crew members: an aircraft commander and two more pilots, two flight engineers, six loadmasters, and a flying crew chief from the 436th Aircraft Maintenance Squadron. The account does not explain the staffing choice, but it does show what a crowded flight deck can absorb. In the preflight briefing, aircraft commander Capt. Geoffrey Howard stressed communication and crew resource management across the three crew positions, a theme that would matter within days.

And it had a lot to absorb. The crew spent four and a half days at Barksdale Air Force Base (BAD), Louisiana, before an unscheduled return to Dover to fix an inoperative weather radar. Then, climbing through 18,000 feet (5,486 meters), a pressure-door warning lit up the pilot, co-pilot, and flight engineer displays. Flight engineer Tech. Sgt. Alexander Barnes confirmed cabin pressure was stable, and the crew ran the checklist that called for descending below 10,000 feet (3,048 meters).
body_zh: 安东尼奥热衷于推广航空、飞行之美及其背后的科学，是航空杂志和书籍的狂热读者，他喜欢参观世界各地的航展，也喜欢拍摄有关飞机和直升机的照片和撰写有关飞机和直升机的文章。他目前居住在西西里岛巴勒莫。
洛克希德 C-5M 超级银河飞机的起飞重量为 840,000 磅（381,024 公斤），但美国空军的标准机组人员只有 7 人。然而，2020 年 1 月，一架载有 12 名机组人员的飞机离开多佛空军基地 (DOV)，并在途中度过了 15 天。差异不仅仅是数字问题：它提出了一个问题：操作世界上最大的军用运输机之一需要什么。
那么为什么该航班需要另外五个人呢？答案涉及 C-5M 的机组人员结构、长途任务的要求以及飞机离开地面之前做出的决定。了解这种差异还有助于解释为什么空军为“银河”保留的机组人员数量比较小的 C-17 环球霸王 III 的机组人员多。
根据空中机动司令部情况说明书，C-5M 的标准机组人员包括一名飞行员、一名副驾驶、两名飞行工程师和三名装载管理员。 《空军杂志》独立列出了相同的细目，《空军与太空部队杂志》也同意这一点。飞行员驾驶飞机，其他五名负责系统监控和货物操作。他们的职责有助于解释为什么 C-5M 比一些较新的军用运输机需要更多的机组人员。

他们驾驶的飞机一点也不普通。据同一份情况说明书报道，货舱长 143 英尺 9 英寸（43.8 米），宽 19 英尺（5.79 米），高 13 英尺 6 英寸（4.11 米），有 36 个托盘位置，最大有效载荷为 281,001 磅（127,460 公斤）。四台发动机的额定推力为 51,250 磅（228 kN），推动它以 518 英里/小时（833.5 公里/小时）的速度行驶。空中加油可以延长飞机的航程，尽管机组人员的耐力仍然是长途任务的限制因素。即使不加油，一架载重 281,001 磅的 C-5M 也可以飞行 2,150 海里（3,982 公里）、卸载并继续飞行 500 海里（926 公里）到达第二基地。这种操作需要飞行机组和装载管理员之间的协调。目前，空军拥有 52 架此类飞机，分布在四个基地，每架飞机都需要担任同样的七个角色。
七名船员中的三名是装卸工，这使他们成为标准船员中最大的一组。那么，一旦引擎运行，三个负载大师实际上会做什么呢？
装载管理员的职责在起飞前开始并持续到整个任务期间。根据圣安东尼奥-拉克兰联合基地（JBSA）的培训简介，装载管理员负责装卸、飞机系统的飞行前和飞行后检查、重量和平衡计算、空投以及决定多少货物和多少乘客去哪里。在 C-5M 上，这项工作同时是物理和数学工作。

C-5M 的设计为装载管理员提供了多种处理超大货物的方法。当后坡道降低时，它的机头可以向上摆动，从而允许在飞机两端进行装载操作。据空中机动司令部称，全宽驶入坡道还可容纳双排车辆。 《空军与太空部队》杂志列出了两辆 M1 艾布拉姆斯坦克、六架波音 AH-64 阿帕奇直升机或七辆防地雷反伏击车等负载。起落架甚至可以跪下，降低地板，这样高大的货物就更容易滚上飞机。每一个负载都必须放置好，以便飞机保持平衡，这就是校舍从数学开始的原因。那里的一位教练直言不讳地说：如果这部分不及格，你就出局。
随着货物的安全，标准机组中的另外两个非飞行员职位​​成为焦点：飞行工程师。它们的作用基本上已经从现代航空公司的驾驶舱中消失，但 C-5M 仍然依靠它们来监控飞机的系统。
为什么 C-5 Galaxy 仍然需要两名飞行工程师

C-5 的驾驶舱反映了该飞机设计的时代。当 Galaxy 在 20 世纪 60 年代开发时，大型飞机通常配备专门的飞行工程师来监控系统并协助飞行员。正如《Simple Flying》所解释的那样，Galaxy 的构想是在 20 世纪 60 年代，早在玻璃驾驶舱出现之前，其使命直到其使用寿命的很晚才证明数字航空电子设备的合理性。 JBSA 的同一份资料称，飞行工程师在远离母站的地方处理飞行前、飞行中和飞行后的检查，并根据空速和大气数据计算出发动机燃油消耗。
现代化改变了飞行工程师的工作方式，但并没有消除这个角色。 《飞行员杂志》指出，升级带来了平板显示器、新的导航和安全设备以及新的自动驾驶仪。空中机动司令部还表示，诊断系统现在记录了 7,000 多个测试点的数据。据《空军与太空部队》杂志报道，飞行工程师仍然负责监控飞机的系统，而驾驶舱显示的进一步升级仍在开发中。稍后我们将确切地看到飞行工程师如何在一次出错的任务中赢得这个座位。
C-17 的情况说明书显示只有 3 名机组人员。其较小的船员数量减少了人力需求、风险暴露和长期成本。 C-5M 的标准机组人员数量是其两倍多，但 2020 年 1 月的一次任务出发时机上有 12 人。如果三个人就能操作一架大型运输机，为什么一次 C-5M 任务需要 12 个人来发射？
紧急呼叫、等待、航行通告 — 实时信号，无需注册。
为什么 C-5 Galaxy 在 2020 年搭载 12 名机组人员飞行

七人是标准的机组人员编制，而不是对可以分配给任务的人数的限制。据空中机动司令部报道，这架 REACH 190 于 2020 年 1 月 13 日离开多佛，共有 12 名机组人员：一名机长和另外两名飞行员、两名飞行工程师、六名装卸工和一名来自第 436 飞机维修中队的飞行机组长。该报道没有解释人员配置的选择，但它确实显示了拥挤的驾驶舱可以容纳的内容。在飞行前简报中，飞机指挥官杰弗里·霍华德上尉强调了三个机组位置之间的沟通和机组资源管理，这个主题将在几天内变得重要。

它有很多东西需要吸收。机组人员在路易斯安那州巴克斯代尔空军基地 (BAD) 待了四天半，然后计划外返回多佛修复失效的气象雷达。然后，爬升到 18,000 英尺（5,486 米）的高度时，压力门警告点亮了飞行员、副驾驶和飞行工程师的显示屏。飞行工程师技术。中士。亚历山大·巴恩斯 (Alexander Barnes) 确认机舱压力稳定，机组人员执行了要求下降到 10,000 英尺（3,048 米）以下的检查表。

title_en: Here’s Why Dassault Scrapped The Falcon 5X Before It Ever Entered Service
title_zh: 这就是达索在猎鹰 5X 投入使用之前就将其报废的原因
summary: A near-ready flagship cabin, with fighter-derived fly-by-wire controls, sat grounded due to a shortfall in French turbofans.
summary_zh: 由于法国涡轮风扇发动机的短缺，配备战斗机电传操纵装置的旗舰机舱几乎准备就绪，但仍处于停飞状态。
body_en: Ethan is an aviation professional with a degree in Aviation Management with Flight from the Florida Institute of Technology. He previously wrote aviation and tourism features for Florida Tech’s student newspaper, The Crimson , where he developed a clear, reader‑focused reporting style. Aviation journalism has remained a consistent priority throughout his career.

He currently holds a Restricted ATP and Commercial Multi‑Engine Pilot certificate and works in aviation supply chain and aircraft component repair. Alongside his industry role, he is pursuing his Certified Flight Instructor rating and actively building flight experience.
A lifelong aviation enthusiast, Ethan spent countless hours at Raleigh–Durham International Airport’s observation deck studying air traffic and practicing amateur photography and videography.

The Boeing 787-3 was a planned program for Boeing's lineup of commercial aircraft. However, the program was canceled before the first example took flight. As with most product lines that never take flight, firms typically cancel them well before the first flight, or even before the first manufactured example takes shape. Dassault Falcon Jet Corporation developed a platform that made it through most of the planning stages and even flew a series of test flights.

The Dassault Falcon 5X was originally announced at the NBAA Convention in Las Vegas in October 2013, according to Monarch Air Group . This program was intended to become Dassault's largest and most technologically advanced business jet. Promised to debut as the corporate aviation manufacturer's new flagship, it drew significant market interest, although only limited order disclosures are publicly known.

Most business jets in the modern jet age are powered by reputable engine manufacturers. Gulfstream , Bombardier , and Textron Aviation products are commonly powered by Honeywell , Pratt & Whitney , General Electric (GE), and Rolls-Royce engine models, among other offerings. The Falcon 5X was designed in collaboration with a unique player in the powerplant marketplace, located near its main headquarters in France.

Safran developed an in-house business aviation powerplant subdivision known as Silvercrest. Aviation International News reported back in 2006 when the program was launched, that it promised an alternative to traditional engine manufacturers; Safran's extensive background in the supply chain for a wide variety of airframe components was a signal of the French Corporation's bandwidth to develop its own engines. Unfortunately, the Silvercrest turbofan quickly emerged as a bottleneck for the Falcon 5X program. Technical problems repeatedly delayed entry into service, turning what began as a competitive advantage into the program's greatest liability.

The program was effectively terminated in 2017, according to Safran 's press release on the unit. Vadim Feldzer, a spokesperson for Dassault Aviation, said the Falcon 5X program is old news, with new offerings currently on the market.
"The 5X program got canceled almost 10 years ago. It’s an old story now."
What Went Wrong With Safran's Silvercrest Engine?
Credit: Alphacit Newim Reporter | Shutterstock

The core issue centered on Silvercrest's high-pressure compressor. During development and testing, the engine encountered performance shortcomings that prevented it from meeting certification requirements. Safran repeatedly modified the design to solve the problem, but each redesign required additional testing and validation. AOPA reports that Textron's Cessna was also interested in the Silvercrest for their super mid-size Citation Longitude, prior to switching to Honeywell’s 7,600-lbst HTF7700L engines.

In a similar fashion to Pratt & Whitney Geared Turbofan (GTF) engine shortages and manufacturing defects for the Airbus A320neo and Airbus A321neo families, the Silvercrest engine faced similar production challenges. As a result, this delayed the airframe program as a whole, forcing Dassault to wait until production delays cleared. Unfortunately for Dassault and Safran, that day never came.
Safran's Various Propulsion Entities Cover a Broad Array of Components
CFM International (50/50 Joint Venture with GE Aerospace)
A320neo, Airbus A330 , Airbus A350 , LEAP nacelles
Demonstrator for next-generation single-aisle aircraft engines

Safran and CFM both outline their propulsion product lines on their websites, many of which are collaborative. Beyond power-generating products, Safran also has entities specializing in cabin interiors, landing gear assemblies, and more. The Safran Aircraft Engines Division was primarily responsible for the engineering behind the Silvercrest engine, but has since pivoted to focus solely on its collaborations with CFM on the Leap engine and CFM56 engine.
Why Was Flying The Aircraft Not Enough To Save The Program?

An aircraft manufacturer does not certify a business jet as separate pieces, but rather as one complete, customer-ready unit. As a result, regulators can certify the entire package, including the exact engines customers will receive. Although the Falcon 5X successfully completed its maiden flight on July 5, 2017, the program remained dependent on a certified production-standard Silvercrest engine before deliveries could begin.
body_zh: Ethan 是一名航空专业人士，拥有佛罗里达理工学院飞行管理学位。他此前曾为佛罗里达理工学院的学生报纸《The Crimson》撰写航空和旅游专题文章，在那里他开发了一种清晰、以读者为中心的报道风格。在他的整个职业生涯中，航空新闻始终是优先考虑的事情。
他目前持有受限 ATP 和商业多引擎飞行员证书，从事航空供应链和飞机部件维修工作。除了他的行业角色外，他还追求认证飞行教练评级并积极积累飞行经验。
伊森是一位终生的航空爱好者，他在罗利-达勒姆国际机场的观景台上花费了无数时间研究空中交通并练习业余摄影和摄像。
波音 787-3 是波音商用飞机系列的一个计划项目。然而，该计划在第一个例子起飞之前就被取消了。与大多数从未起飞的产品线一样，公司通常会在首次飞行之前，甚至在第一个制造的示例成型之前就取消它们。达索猎鹰喷气机公司开发了一个平台，该平台完成了大部分规划阶段，甚至进行了一系列试飞。
据君主航空集团称，达索猎鹰 5X 最初于 2013 年 10 月在拉斯维加斯举行的 NBAA 大会上发布。该计划旨在成为达索最大、技术最先进的公务机。它承诺作为公务航空制造商的新旗舰首次亮相，吸引了巨大的市场兴趣，尽管公众只知道有限的订单披露。
现代喷气机时代的大多数公务机均由信誉良好的发动机制造商提供动力。湾流、庞巴迪和德事隆航空产品通常由霍尼韦尔、普惠、通用电气 (GE) 和劳斯莱斯等发动机型号提供动力。 Falcon 5X 是与动力装置市场上一家独特的公司合作设计的，该公司位于其法国总部附近。

赛峰集团开发了一个名为 Silvercrest 的内部公务航空动力装置部门。 《航空国际新闻》早在 2006 年该计划启动时就曾报道称，它承诺为传统发动机制造商提供替代方案；赛峰集团在各种机身部件的供应链中拥有广泛的背景，这表明这家法国公司有能力开发自己的发动机。不幸的是，Silvercrest 涡轮风扇发动机很快成为 Falcon 5X 计划的瓶颈。技术问题一再推迟投入使用，使最初的竞争优势变成了该计划的最大责任。
根据赛峰集团关于该部门的新闻稿，该计划实际上已于 2017 年终止。达索航空发言人 Vadim Feldzer 表示，Falcon 5X 计划已经是旧闻，目前市场上有新产品。
“5X 计划大约 10 年前就被取消了。现在这已经是一个老故事了。”
赛峰集团的 Silvercrest 发动机出了什么问题？
图片来源：Alphacit Newim 记者 | Shutterstock
核心问题集中在 Silvercrest 的高压压缩机上。在开发和测试过程中，该发动机遇到了性能缺陷，无法满足认证要求。赛峰集团反复修改设计来解决该问题，但每次重新设计都需要额外的测试和验证。 AOPA 报道称，在改用霍尼韦尔的 7,600 磅 HTF7700L 发动机之前，德事隆旗下的塞斯纳公司也对 Silvercrest 的超中型 Citation Longitude 感兴趣。
与空客 A320neo 和空客 A321neo 系列的普惠齿轮传动涡轮风扇 (GTF) 发动机短缺和制造缺陷类似，Silvercrest 发动机也面临着类似的生产挑战。结果，这延迟了整个机身计划，迫使达索公司等待生产延误得到解决。不幸的是，对于达索和赛峰集团来说，这一天从未到来。
赛峰集团的各种推进实体涵盖广泛的组件
CFM International（与 GE Aerospace 50/50 合资企业）
A320neo、空客 A330、空客 A350、LEAP 短舱
下一代单通道飞机发动机演示机
赛峰集团和 CFM 都在各自的网站上概述了各自的推进产品线，其中许多产品线是合作的。除了发电产品外，赛峰集团还拥有专门从事机舱内饰、起落架总成等业务的实体。赛峰飞机发动机部门主要负责 Silvercrest 发动机背后的工程设计，但此后转而专注于与 CFM 在 Leap 发动机和 CFM56 发动机方面的合作。
为什么驾驶飞机不足以挽救该计划？
飞机制造商不会将公务机作为单独的部件进行认证，而是作为一个完整的、可供客户使用的单元进行认证。因此，监管机构可以对整个包进行认证，包括客户将收到的确切发动机。尽管 Falcon 5X 于 2017 年 7 月 5 日成功完成首飞，但该项目在开始交付之前仍然依赖于经过认证的生产标准 Silvercrest 发动机。

title_en: Airbus' Hidden Airspace Design Tricks That Make Narrowbody Cabins Feel Bigger
title_zh: 空客的隐藏空域设计技巧让窄体客舱感觉更大
summary: Airbus made the A320 cabin feel bigger without touching the fuselage. Research suggests some tricks work better than others.
summary_zh: 空中客车公司在不接触机身的情况下让 A320 的机舱感觉更大。研究表明，有些技巧比其他技巧更有效。
body_en: Airbus' Hidden Airspace Design Tricks That Make Narrowbody Cabins Feel Bigger

Brandon's passion for aviation started at a young age. He became involved in the flight simulator and VATSIM communities, which sparked his interest in aviation and eventually led him to earn his private pilot license. Outside of work, he continues to build flight hours, explore new airports, and stay involved in the aviation community.

Airbus announced the Airspace cabin for the A320 family at the Paris Air Show in June 2017, translating design language developed for the A350 XWB and A330neo onto a narrowbody fuselage. The package is retrofittable, which defines its scope. Nothing structural moves. The sidewall panels, overhead bins, window bezels, lighting, and lavatories all change, while the cross-section underneath stays where it is. Redesigned sidewalls add roughly one inch at head and shoulder level. The bins abandoned the tilt-down design for a fixed configuration, holding eight bags per four-frame bin against five, a 40% volume increase . A hero ceiling light with 16.4 million color options runs the length of the cabin.

Manufacturers are explicit about what this is for. Boeing holds a patent on aircraft ceiling illumination, stating that the lighting systems exist to change the passenger's perception of the cabin, particularly the ceiling height. The research on whether it works is less settled. A study using eye tracking and virtual reality found a significant relationship between window opening size and perceived spaciousness, while ceiling geometry did not achieve statistical significance. Airspace changed the window bezel rather than the opening, and built its spaciousness claim on the ceiling light.

Airbus redesigned the A320 family's sidewall panels as part of the Airspace cabin, adding about one inch of width. Where that inch sits is the point. Airbus placed it at head and shoulder level rather than distributing it along the full height of the cabin wall. At launch, the company said it increased cabin width by about an inch in the key head-and-shoulder areas, and Aviation Week reported that the redesign provides one extra inch of shoulder-level space per seat in the 3-3 economy cabin. The word Airbus used mattered, as it reflects a judgment about where passengers register space rather than a measurement.

Research into personal space in aircraft cabins supports treating that as the relevant zone. A 2021 study published in Mathematical Problems in Engineering examined personal space invasion and identified 14 contributing factors drawn from passenger accounts, mapping tactile sensation as the largest category with 140 recorded descriptors, ahead of other sensory factors at 101. Contact and proximity, rather than overall cabin volume, dominate how passengers describe feeling crowded. The study also mapped passenger movement to passage width as a design index, identifying the aisle and sidewall as contributors.

An inch is a modest figure against the baseline. The A320 fuselage already provides what Airbus markets as the widest single-aisle cabin in production, with 18-inch seats, and the manufacturer has used that width against the Boeing 737 for decades. Nothing structural moved in the Airspace redesign. The panels covering the structure moved, which is the distinction running throughout the entire package.

Airbus abandoned the tilt-down overhead bins used widely across the industry in favor of a fixed configuration . The capacity increase is 40% more volume, holding eight bags per four-frame bin versus five previously, and accommodating bags as large as 24 by 16 by 10 inches. Airbus markets them as the largest overhead bins in any single-aisle cabin, sufficient for one carry-on bag per passenger.

The gain comes from orientation. The Points Guy noted at launch that bags fit best when stored vertically, with four per bin section, using the compartment's full depth rather than the fraction a flat-lying bag occupies.

Researchers have studied bin dimensions as a distinct variable in passenger experience. A paper presented at the 2018 International Conference on Applied Human Factors and Ergonomics mapped overhead bin storage-space height as an underlying factor in passenger experience , measured through real-size projection experiments, and placed it alongside ceiling height as a quantifiable element of perceived space rather than a purely practical one. Separately, a TU Delft study found that the Boeing Sky Interior, which combined a redesigned ceiling lighting system with different overhead bins, produced a measurable positive effect on passenger comfort perception. The study assessed the bins and lighting together, as Airbus has also deployed them.
The Research Says Airbus Changed The Wrong Part Of The Window

The A320's cabin windows are smaller than those on a Boeing 737, and Airspace did not change them. The packaging changed the bezel around each window, restyling it to give the impression of a larger viewing space. The Points Guy described the effect at the launch, noting the new design gives the impression of a larger viewing space even with the A320's smaller windows. Aviation Week reported that fully integrated window shades provide more window space and an unobstructed view, evoking the feel of the A350.

Research on perceived spaciousness suggests the frame is the least important variable. A study using screen-based assessment with eye tracking and virtual reality evaluations examined four design elements affecting perceived spaciousness in interior environments: view access, view content, materiality, and ceiling geometry. It reported that research on windows and spaciousness indicates a significant relationship between opening size and perceived spaciousness. Opening size is precisely what Airspace leaves alone.

That does not make the bezel redesign worthless. View access was among the elements the study examined, and removing the visual obstruction of a separate shade track increases how much of the opening a passenger can actually see through. Airbus now markets the result as a panoramic window design, which is generous language for a redesigned frame around an unchanged aperture. It remains the clearest example in the package of addressing a perception problem rather than a dimensional one, and the evidence suggests it is also the element where perception and reality diverge most.
Lighting Is The Trick Manufacturers Have Patented

The centerpiece of the Airspace cabin is what Airbus calls the hero ceiling light: a customizable strip running the length of the cabin, supported by full-color RGB LEDs offering 16.4 million color options, plus separate welcome lighting at the entrance. Airbus answers its own question about what makes the cabin look spacious by citing the A320 cross-section width and the hero light as creating a spacious feeling. The central strip remains visible even when the overhead bins are open.
body_zh: 空客的隐藏空域设计技巧让窄体客舱感觉更大
布兰登从小就对航空充满热情。他参与了飞行模拟器和 VATSIM 社区，这激发了他对航空的兴趣，并最终使他获得了私人飞行员执照。工作之余，他继续增加飞行时间、探索新机场并继续参与航空界。

空中客车公司在 2017 年 6 月的巴黎航展上宣布了 A320 系列的空域客舱，将为 A350 XWB 和 A330neo 开发的设计语言转化为窄体机身。该套件是可改装的，这定义了其范围。没有任何结构性变动。侧壁板、头顶行李箱、窗框、照明和盥洗室都发生了变化，而下面的横截面保持原样。重新设计的侧壁在头部和肩部高度增加了大约一英寸。这些垃圾箱放弃了向下倾斜的设计，采用固定配置，每个四框垃圾箱可容纳 8 个袋子，而每个框架箱可容纳 5 个袋子，体积增加了 40%。拥有 1640 万种颜色选择的英雄顶灯贯穿整个机舱。
制造商明确说明其用途。波音公司拥有飞机天花板照明的专利，指出照明系统的存在是为了改变乘客对机舱的感知，特别是天花板高度。关于它是否有效的研究还不太确定。一项使用眼动追踪和虚拟现实的研究发现窗户开口尺寸与感知的宽敞度之间存在显着关系，而天花板几何形状并未达到统计显着性。空域改变了窗户边框而不是开口，并在天花板灯上建立了其宽敞的主张。

空中客车公司重新设计了 A320 系列的侧壁板作为空域客舱的一部分，增加了约一英寸的宽度。那一英寸所在的位置就是重点。空中客车公司将其放置在头和肩的高度，而不是沿着机舱壁的整个高度分布。该公司在推出时表示，其头肩部关键区域的机舱宽度增加了约一英寸，《航空周刊》报道称，重新设计后，3-3 经济舱的每个座位的肩部空间增加了一英寸。空中客车公司使用的这个词很重要，因为它反映了对乘客登记空间的判断，而不是测量。
对飞机机舱内个人空间的研究支持将其视为相关区域。 2021 年发表在《工程数学问题》上的一项研究检查了个人空间入侵，并从乘客的账户中确定了 14 个影响因素，将触觉列为最大的类别，有 140 个记录的描述符，领先于其他感官因素，有 101 个。接触和接近，而不是整个机舱体积，主导了乘客对拥挤感觉的描述。该研究还将乘客移动与通道宽度作为设计指标，并将过道和侧壁确定为贡献者。
相对于基线来说，一英寸是一个适中的数字。 A320 机身已经提供了空中客车公司所销售的生产中最宽的单通道客舱，配有 18 英寸的座椅，并且该制造商数十年来一直使用该宽度来对抗波音 737。空域重新设计中没有任何结构性变化。覆盖结构的面板移动了，这是贯穿整个包装的区别。
空中客车公司放弃了整个行业广泛使用的倾斜式头顶行李箱，转而采用固定配置。容量增加了 40%，每个四框垃圾箱可容纳 8 个袋子，而之前只能容纳 5 个，并且可容纳最大 24 x 16 x 10 英寸的袋子。空中客车公司将其定位为单通道客舱中最大的头顶行李箱，足以容纳每位乘客一件随身行李。
增益来自于方向。 Points Guy 在发布时指出，垂直存放的袋子最适合，每个垃圾箱部分有四个，使用隔间的整个深度而不是平放的袋子所占的部分。

研究人员将行李箱尺寸作为乘客体验的一个独特变量进行了研究。在 2018 年应用人为因素和人体工程学国际会议上发表的一篇论文将头顶行李箱存储空间高度映射为乘客体验的基本因素，通过实际尺寸的投影实验进行测量，并将其与天花板高度一起作为感知空间的可量化元素，而不是纯粹的实用元素。另外，代尔夫特理工大学的一项研究发现，波音天空内饰将重新设计的天花板照明系统与不同的头顶行李箱相结合，对乘客的舒适感产生了可衡量的积极影响。该研究同时评估了垃圾箱和照明，因为空中客车公司也部署了它们。
研究称空客改变了窗户的错误部分
A320 的机舱窗户比波音 737 的小，Airspace 没有对其进行更改。包装改变了每个窗户周围的边框，重新设计，给人以更大的观看空间的印象。 The Points Guy 描述了发布会上的效果，指出即使 A320 的窗户较小，新设计也给人留下了更大观看空间的印象。 《航空周刊》报道称，完全集成的窗帘提供了更多的窗户空间和一览无余的视野，让人想起 A350 的感觉。
对感知空间的研究表明，框架是最不重要的变量。一项使用基于屏幕的评估、眼动追踪和虚拟现实评估的研究检查了影响室内环境感知宽敞度的四个设计元素：视图访问、视图内容、物质性和天花板几何形状。据报道，对窗户和宽敞度的研究表明，开口尺寸与感知的宽敞度之间存在显着关系。开口尺寸正是Airspace 所不考虑的。
但这并不意味着边框的重新设计毫无价值。视野访问是该研究检查的要素之一，消除单独遮阳轨道的视觉障碍会增加乘客实际可以看到的开口范围。空中客车公司现在将其产品作为全景窗户设计进行营销，这是围绕未改变的光圈重新设计的框架的慷慨语言。它仍然是解决感知问题而不是维度问题的最明显的例子，而且证据表明它也是感知和现实分歧最大的因素。
照明是制造商已申请专利的技巧
Airspace 客舱的核心是空中客车公司所称的英雄顶灯：一条可定制的条带贯穿客舱的长度，由全彩 RGB LED 提供 1640 万种颜色选择，以及入口处的独立迎宾照明。空中客车公司通过引用 A320 的横截面宽度和英雄灯创造了一种宽敞的感觉来回答自己关于是什么让机舱看起来宽敞的问题。即使头顶行李箱打开，中央条带仍然可见。

Dallas' third airport is set to open to commercial passengers from mid-November; however, one of the world's largest airlines will not be operating to the airport. McKinney National Airport (DTX) is set to become the city's third major airport, but Southwest Airlines is not interested, with the carrier's Chief Executive Officer Bob Jordan suggesting the numbers don't stack up to WFAA .

Southwest maintains an extensive network from Dallas Love Field (DAL), and has no operations at Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW). The new airport at McKinney on the north side of Dallas, for the foreseeable future, will have no Southwest services, leaving Avelo to become the airport's only operator.

Southwest Airlines Considered Operating To McKinney, But It Doesn't Work

McKinney has hoped to lure in the all-Boeing 737 operator to the airport; however, Southwest has noted that while the airport is the newest commercial air hub in the country, it was not the 'right fit' for the airline. Jordan emphasized that the airport did not fit into the airline's operational plan for a number of reasons.

Jordan remains unfazed by the opening of McKinney, suggesting that he was not worried about the additional competition for those looking to fly from the new Texas airport. From Love Field , Southwest operates to 80 domestic destinations, with 64 year-round services, and an additional 16 that are added seasonally. The airline has no international flights from the airport.

Avelo will begin operating at McKinney from November 11, with its first service headed to Fort Myers (RSW). This will mark the airline's first of 11 routes to be served from the new airport. Full details of the airline's new network below
Fort Lauderdale, Fort Myers, Orlando, Sarasota, Tampa, West Palm Beach
McKinney National Airport: Dallas' Newest Gateway

McKinney National is an airport that was originally established for general aviation, including private planes, corporate fleets, and ongoing flight training. The airport has a single runway (18/36) that spans 7,002 feet (2,134 meters). The airport has undergone an extensive transformation and developed a new passenger terminal in a bid to lure in commercial air services.
The airport will act as an alternative gateway for travelers in Dallas' northern suburbs, and Avelo will become the first commercial operator to the airport with routes to key leisure markets.

McKinney is located 30 miles (48 kilometers) north of Downtown Dallas, and in 2025, the city's officials approved a $72 million commercial passenger terminal, which has been built on the east side of the airport. The terminal has four gates and recently became the state's newest commercial airport in more than 20 years .

Delta will begin serving the route to Bentonville from Austin nonstop from March 7, adding to the airline's expanding network at both Austin and the Northwest Arkansas airport. Flights, which are already available to purchase, will see the service depart daily from Bentonville early in the morning, with a late-night return from Austin.

Delta flight 3625 departs from Bentonville at 6:00 AM daily for the one-hour and 50-minute journey to Austin, with a scheduled arrival time of 7:50 AM. Return flights from Austin operate as DL3626, pushing back from the gate at 8:59 PM, for a 10:49 PM touchdown in Bentonville.

Flights for the service are operated by the Embraer 175, operated by SkyWest Airlines under the Delta Connection brand. The aircraft is equipped with up to 76 seats onboard. Snacks and drinks are provided on the flight.
Delta Aims To Capture High Business Travel Demand

For those unaware, the world's largest retailer is based in Bentonville. Walmart is headquartered in the city, which produces huge demand for corporate air travel. This has ultimately created heavy route demand to key destinations across the US. Delta's latest route addition, with Austin coming online in March, provides more direct connectivity for both business and leisure travelers.

Late last year, Delta added another route from the Arkansas airport, with a nonstop service to Salt Lake City International Airport (SLC). This provided travelers from the city with another nonstop service to the West Coast. What made the airline's approach unique on this route was that it proposed a 'use it or lose it' proposition, which suggested that the airline wanted travelers to make the most of the service; otherwise, if it had poor load factors, it would be dropped. A year later, the route remains. Read more about this approach here .

Data from The Frequent Flyer shows Delta as the second-largest operator at the airport after American Airlines. Delta holds around 20.4% market share of all flights from the airport. During the period from May 2025 to April 2026, it carried 512,000 passengers. American, the largest operator, has a 48.5% market share, with patronage of 1.2 million annual passengers. title_en: Why United Airlines Is Opening Up Flight Attendant Bases In Cities Almost No One Would Expect
title_zh: 为什么联合航空要在几乎无人预料到的城市开设空乘人员基地
summary: A closer look at the logic behind United's next two flight attendant domiciles, and why this isn't as unusual as you'd think.
summary_zh: 仔细研究一下美联航接下来的两个空乘人员住所背后的逻辑，以及为什么这并不像您想象的那么不寻常。
body_en: Daniel comes to Simple Flying with a business focused approach to the aviation world. Daniel enjoys analyzing strategy and how companies move against each other to gain a step ahead in the skies. Besides strategy, Daniel also has a passion for aircraft design and the history of aviation.

Essentially all airlines have hubs where most routes originate, where planes are based, and where crew members are based. United Airlines has eight hubs, located in Newark, Washington DC, Chicago, Houston, Denver, Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Guam, and in these eight hubs, the airline also has pilot and flight attendant domiciles.

Although the hubs are located at specific airports, the crew domiciles cover all airports in the market, meaning that a Newark-based crew member can also operate a trip originating in LaGuardia, for instance. Domiciles usually line up with where an airline has its hubs, but the two are not the same, and this can be seen in the two latest flight attendant domiciles that the airline has recently announced.

United will now base flight attendants in Sacramento, a small spoke market, and in Dallas/Fort Worth, which is American Airlines' largest hub. United is not planning to set up hubs in either airport, but there will now be small groups of flight attendants whose trips originate in these cities.
Why United Is Basing Flight Attendants Out Of These Cities

Fundamentally, airlines place crew domiciles in cities where a high volume of flights originate/terminate, which is why you see domiciles at almost every hub that an airline operates. By relieving pilots and flight attendants from duty, an airline saves money on lodging, per diem, and transportation, since once the trip ends, it's the crew member's responsibility to get home.

Similarly, it's the crew member's responsibility to show up to their domicile before the trip officially begins, not the airline's . However, airlines may still have a significant number of crew members living in a non-hub airport, while certain spokes may have a significant number of flights.

In these cases, sending crew members to hotels incurs expenses that might not be necessary depending on the scale of the operation. United has not revealed the purpose behind setting up domiciles in these specific cities . However, it's likely that the airline has a high number of layovers in these cities or that a significant number of flight attendants already live in these cities, or a combination of both.

In any case, the math worked out that it was more cost-effective to set up domiciles rather than send crews to hotels. Ordinarily, a flight attendant living in Dallas who is based in Houston would first need to commute to Houston to begin their trip.

If that trip involved a layover in Dallas, the company would need to pay for per diem, a hotel, as well as transportation to and from the hotel. With the Dallas crew base, United can schedule trips that originate and end in Dallas. Since a large number of crew members already live in the city, this yields significant cost savings.

These are not standard bases like United's domiciles in its hubs . Instead, these are satellite bases, with the Dallas domicile being a satellite of United's Houston base while Sacramento will be a satellite of the San Francisco domicile. This means that there won't be on-site supervisors, and new hires are not assigned to the satellites as a result.

However, schedule bidding for the satellites is done separately from the main bases, while crews bid into these domiciles based on seniority. The Sacramento and Dallas bases are noteworthy because they seem to be very unusual choices at first glance, but United has long operated satellite bases.

Including the satellites, the airline has 19 flight attendant bases in total, while Sacramento and Dallas will bump the number up to 21. The carrier's satellite bases are located in Tampa, Orlando, Fort Lauderdale, Austin, Phoenix, and San Diego, while United also maintains full bases in Boston, Cleveland, Las Vegas, Honolulu, and London.

All of these bases are relatively small and have limited flying, because they're mainly intended for crew members living in these cities. The airline still schedules layovers in these destinations, and many flights operating out of them will be staffed by crew members from other domiciles. However, it does save United money on layover costs, while it's more convenient for the flight attendants living in these cities . The same also applies to pilots, although on a much smaller scale.

United maintains pilot bases at its eight hub airports, but just like with flight attendants, this doesn't mean that most of its flight crew members live in these cities. As such, United and other airlines often have to pay for layover costs in cities where a pilot may live, yet isn't based out of.

However, there are two main differences in this regard between flight crew and cabin crew: there are far fewer pilots than flight attendants, and pilots are typically only certified to work on one type of aircraft (although common type ratings exist in some cases). This significantly changes the equation when deciding whether to open a new domicile, and it makes it harder for airlines to justify investing in a pilot base not located in a hub.

However, this doesn't mean that it never happens, and United Airlines itself operates four domiciles located in non-hub cities: Cleveland, Las Vegas, Orlando, and Tampa. The Cleveland base is a holdover from Continental Airlines, which did use the city as a hub, while the latter three are much more recent additions. All four of these are Boeing 737 bases, and this further indicates United's rationale for these decisions.

The airline likely has a substantial number of pilots who live in or near these cities, and they are all major spokes for the carrier. In addition, United's narrowbody fleet is much more dominated by the Boeing 737 than those of its rivals, which makes it easier to schedule a large number of 737 trips that originate and terminate in one of the four new domiciles, especially since the 737 is already operating most flights to these cities.

Among its peers, United is hardly unique in operating flight attendant domiciles outside of its hubs. Delta Air Lines operates 20 flight attendant domiciles, including bases in Austin, Cincinnati, Dallas/Fort Worth, Fort Lauderdale, Honolulu, Las Vegas, Orlando, Phoenix, Portland, Raleigh-Durham, San Francisco, and Tampa, in addition to its eight hub cities.

In some cases, the domicile comes with an increased focus on a specific airport, such as with Austin, but it's usually just a method to cut layover costs. Among the three US legacies, American Airlines has the most hubs, operating out of ten airports in nine cities, and it operates flight attendant domiciles in these nine cities.
body_zh: Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。
基本上所有航空公司都拥有大多数航线的始发地、飞机的基地以及机组人员的基地的枢纽。联合航空拥有八个枢纽，分别位于纽瓦克、华盛顿特区、芝加哥、休斯顿、丹佛、洛杉矶、旧金山和关岛，在这八个枢纽中，该航空公司还设有飞行员和空乘人员住所。
尽管枢纽位于特定机场，但机组人员住所覆盖了市场上的所有机场，这意味着纽瓦克的机组人员也可以运营从拉瓜迪亚出发的航班。住所通常与航空公司的枢纽所在地一致，但两者并不相同，这一点从该航空公司最近公布的两个最新空乘人员住所就可以看出。
美联航现在将在萨克拉门托（一个小型​​辐射市场）和达拉斯/沃斯堡（美国航空最大的枢纽）派驻空乘人员。美联航不打算在这两个机场设立枢纽，但现在将有一小群空乘人员的航班从这些城市出发。
为什么美联航将空乘人员迁出这些城市
从根本上说，航空公司将机组人员住所安排在大量航班始发/终止的城市，这就是为什么您在航空公司运营的几乎每个枢纽都看到了住所。通过免除飞行员和空乘人员的职务，航空公司可以节省住宿、每日津贴和交通费用，因为一旦旅行结束，机组人员就有责任回家。
同样，在旅行正式开始之前到达住所是机组人员的责任，而不是航空公司的责任。然而，航空公司可能仍然有大量机组人员居住在非枢纽机场，而某些辐条机场可能有大量航班。
在这些情况下，将船员送往酒店会产生不必要的费用，具体取决于运营规模。曼联尚未透露在这些特定城市设立住所的目的。然而，航空公司可能在这些城市有大量的中途停留，或者大量空乘人员已经居住在这些城市，或者两者兼而有之。
无论如何，经过计算发现，设立住所比将工作人员派往酒店更具成本效益。通常，居住在达拉斯且驻休斯顿的空乘人员首先需要通勤到休斯顿才能开始旅程。
如果这次旅行需要在达拉斯中途停留，公司将需要支付每日津贴、酒店费用以及往返酒店的交通费用。借助达拉斯机组人员基地，美联航可以安排从达拉斯出发和结束的航班。由于大量船员已经居住在该城市，因此可以节省大量成本。
这些不是像曼联在其枢纽中心的住所那样的标准基地。相反，这些是卫星基地，达拉斯基地是曼联休斯顿基地的卫星基地，而萨克拉门托将是旧金山基地的卫星基地。这意味着不会有现场主管，因此新员工也不会分配到卫星。
然而，卫星的时间表招标是与主基地分开进行的，而工作人员则根据资历对这些住所进行投标。萨克拉门托和达拉斯基地值得注意，因为乍一看它们似乎是非常不寻常的选择，但曼联长期以来一直运营着卫星基地。
包括卫星基地在内，美联航共有 19 个空乘基地，而萨克拉门托和达拉斯的空乘基地数量将增至 21 个。该航空公司的卫星基地位于坦帕、奥兰多、劳德代尔堡、奥斯汀、菲尼克斯和圣地亚哥，而美联航还在波士顿、克利夫兰、拉斯维加斯、檀香山和伦敦拥有完整的基地。
所有这些基地都相对较小，飞行也有限，因为它们主要供居住在这些城市的机组人员使用。该航空公司仍然在这些目的地安排中途停留，并且许多从这些目的地出发的航班将配备来自其他住所的机组人员。不过，它确实节省了美联航的中途停留费用，同时对于居住在这些城市的空乘人员来说也更方便。这同样适用于飞行员，尽管规模要小得多。
美联航在其八个枢纽机场设有飞行员基地，但就像空乘人员一样，这并不意味着其大多数机组人员居住在这些城市。因此，美联航和其他航空公司通常必须支付飞行员可能居住但不在其所在地的城市的中途停留费用。
然而，在这方面，机组人员和客舱机组人员之间存在两个主要区别：飞行员比空乘人员少得多，而且飞行员通常只获得在一种类型的飞机上工作的认证（尽管在某些情况下存在共同的类型评级）。这极大地改变了决定是否开设新住所时的等式，并且使航空公司更难证明投资不在枢纽的飞行员基地的合理性。
然而，这并不意味着它永远不会发生，联合航空本身在非枢纽城市运营着四个总部：克利夫兰、拉斯维加斯、奥兰多和坦帕。克利夫兰基地是大陆航空公司的遗留物，该公司确实将该市作为枢纽，而后三个基地则是最近新增的。这四个基地都是波音 737 基地，这进一步表明了美联航做出这些决定的理由。
该航空公司可能拥有大量居住在这些城市或附近城市的飞行员，他们都是该航空公司的主要发言人。此外，与竞争对手相比，美联航的窄体机机队更多地以波音 737 为主，这使得更容易安排在四个新住所之一出发和终止的大量 737 航班，特别是因为 737 已经运营了飞往这些城市的大部分航班。
在同行中，美联航在其枢纽之外运营空乘人员住所并不是唯一一家。达美航空拥有 20 个空乘人员所在地，包括奥斯汀、辛辛那提、达拉斯/沃斯堡、劳德代尔堡、檀香山、拉斯维加斯、奥兰多、菲尼克斯、波特兰、罗利-达勒姆、旧金山和坦帕的基地，以及八个枢纽城市。
在某些情况下，住所会更加关注特定机场，例如奥斯汀，但这通常只是削减中途停留成本的一种方法。在美国三大航空公司中，美国航空拥有最多的枢纽，在九个城市的十个机场中运营，并在这九个城市设有空乘人员住所。

title_en: My Atmos Rewards Summit Card Application Approval Experience
title_zh: 我的 Atmos Rewards Summit 卡申请审批体验
summary: I was instantly approved for the $395 Atmos Rewards Summit Card with a big credit line. Here's how the application works and the Bank of America rules to know.
summary_zh: 我立即获得了价值 395 美元的 Atmos Rewards Summit 卡的批准，并且信用额度很高。以下是该应用程序的工作原理和美国银行的规则
body_en: The $395 annual fee Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite ® Credit Card is the premium credit card of Atmos Rewards, which is the combined loyalty program of Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines.

I’d argue that this is one of the best airline credit cards we’ve seen in a long time, and there are many reasons to pick up this card , from the ability to earn 3x points on foreign purchases , to the Global Companion Awards offered by the card , to the waived partner award booking fees , to the free points sharing , to the Alaska Lounge passes .

Perhaps the most obvious reason to get the Atmos Rewards Summit Card is that it’s offering a limited time welcome bonus , which in and of itself is a reason to apply. Specifically, you can receive 100,000 bonus points and a 25,000-point Global Companion Award with this offer. To qualify, spend $6,000 or more on purchases within the first 90 days of opening your account.

This is in line with the best-ever publicly available welcome offer we’ve seen on the Atmos Rewards Summit Card, and this is exactly the offer with which I applied for the card last year. In this post, I’d like to talk a bit about the rules when it comes to getting approved for the card, and my experience when I applied last year.
Link: Learn more about the Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite ® Credit Card
Basic Atmos Rewards Summit Card application restrictions

The Atmos Rewards Summit Card is issued by Bank of America. The good news is that eligibility for this card is unrelated to having any other card from Bank of America, Atmos Rewards, Alaska, or Hawaiian . So you’re eligible for this card (including the welcome bonus) if you have any other card in the portfolio.
For example, if you look at the terms of the Atmos Rewards Summit Card application, you’ll see the following
This one-time promotion is limited to customers opening a new account in response to this offer and will not apply to requests to convert existing accounts.

That’s great, because it means that anyone who doesn’t yet have this card should be eligible for the bonus. Beyond that, what general restrictions does Bank of America have when it comes to approving people for cards? Here are a couple of common Bank of America restrictions that are often discussed, though let me emphasize that enforcement seems really inconsistent

There’s a 2/3/4 rule, meaning you can open at most two Bank of America cards every two months, at most three Bank of America cards every 12 months, and at most four Bank of America cards every 24 months
There’s a 3/12 rule, meaning you may not be approved for a card if you’ve opened three or more new cards with any card issuer in the past 12 months

Both of these rules are specific to personal cards, and not business cards. Beyond that, neither of those rules seem to be totally consistently enforced, and in particular, that latter policy doesn’t seem consistent at all. For example, I opened more than three new cards in the 12 months before applying, and still ended up being approved.

Bank of America can sometimes be quirky in terms of approvals. I find that with Bank of America, I often get instant approvals with massive credit lines, and then every once in a while, I get random, inexplicable denials. So make of that what you will. If you’re interested in picking up more than one Atmos Rewards card in a day, it’s worth pointing out that you can potentially be approved for two in one day .
Atmos Rewards Summit Card application & approval experience
What’s the application process like when applying for the Atmos Rewards Summit Card? The online application process is really straightforward, and consists of just one page.

It just asks for personal details — name, date of birth, social security number, address, phone number, income, etc. You’ll also be asked for your Atmos Rewards number, so you’ll want to include that, so that your points are credited to the right account.
The process is even simpler if you already have a Bank of America account, as you’ll be asked to log-in with your account, and then you only have to provide updated income information.
For example, I applied for the card when it launched last year, and was instantly approved, with a pretty big credit line, no less!
