title_en: JetBlue’s Loan Companies Hire Special Advisors Over Repayment Concerns Of $8.4 Billion Debt
title_zh: 捷蓝航空的贷款公司聘请特别顾问应对 84 亿美元债务的偿还问题
summary: JetBlue leadership remains set on no restructuring plans.
summary_zh: 捷蓝航空领导层仍然没有重组计划。
body_en: JetBlue’s Loan Companies Hire Special Advisors Over Repayment Concerns Of $8.4 Billion Debt

Jack comes to Simple Flying with a lifelong interest in all things aviation. He holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech, and is a certified private and remote pilot. Beyond these experiences, Jack previously worked for a corporate flight department where he gained first-hand experience in the world of business aviation. Currently, Jack works in the professional services industry and continues to build his flight hours outside of work.

A group of JetBlue Airways creditors has hired financial adviser PJT Partners and law firm Akin Gump as concerns grow over the airline’s ability to manage its debt and finance a turnaround. The group reportedly includes investors holding approximately $2 billion in bonds due in 2031 and a $742 million first-lien loan. The appointments suggest lenders are preparing for potential negotiations, although they do not mean JetBlue has filed for bankruptcy or agreed to restructure its obligations.

The airline’s broader debt and finance lease obligations total approximately $8.4 billion. Chief Executive Joanna Geraghty told Reuters on October 27 that JetBlue was not in talks with creditors and was not considering restructuring. Her comments followed a sharp decline in the carrier’s bonds, raising questions about its ability to recover financially without renegotiating its borrowing arrangements.
Creditors Bring In Advisers As JetBlue Bonds Lose Value

Bloomberg reported that JetBlue creditors holding the $2 billion bond issue and the $742 million loan are working with PJT Partners and Akin Gump. Neither JetBlue nor the firms publicly confirmed the appointments when the reports emerged. The pressure is particularly visible in JetBlue’s TrueBlue senior secured notes, backed by the airline’s loyalty programs . The approximately $2 billion bond issue traded at about 47 cents on October 26, down from around 80 cents at the beginning of the month. Its yield climbed above 30%, reflecting investors’ heightened concerns about repayment, according to LSEG data cited by Reuters.

Falling bond prices do not establish that a company will default. They do indicate that investors view repayment as riskier than before. Creditors often hire restructuring specialists to assess their options, review a borrower’s financial position, and prepare for possible discussions about repayment terms or collateral. The advisers represent the lenders, not JetBlue , and their appointment does not initiate bankruptcy proceedings.
Losses And Fuel Costs Complicate The Airline’s Turnaround

Debt concerns coincide with continued financial losses and higher operating expenses. The airline reported a third-quarter net loss of $257 million, compared with $143 million a year earlier. Its net loss for the first nine months of 2026 nearly doubled to $823 million, while third-quarter fuel expense increased 61%. Revenue , however, rose more than 20% to approximately $2.8 billion.

The carrier used $273 million in cash from operations during the first nine months of the year, nearly twice the amount recorded over the same period in 2025. Unrestricted cash and investments fell by about $850 million to $1.6 billion at the end of September. Its working-capital deficit also widened to $1.6 billion, compared with $1.2 billion at the end of 2025.

JetBlue reported $2.2 billion in liquidity and approximately $7 billion in assets not already pledged to lenders. However, about two-thirds of its owned property, equipment, and intangible assets by book value were already pledged as collateral, limiting the assets available to secure additional financing. The airline also faces scheduled debt and finance lease repayments of $477 million in 2027, $582 million in 2028, and $1.8 billion in 2029, according to its third-quarter filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission .
JetBlue Rejects Restructuring Speculation & Maintains Recovery Targets

Geraghty has sought to distance the airline from speculation about a potential restructuring. Speaking to Reuters, she said JetBlue was not negotiating with creditors, had no intention of filing for bankruptcy, and was not seeking financial support from the United States government. Management maintains that the company has sufficient liquidity to cover its needs for at least the next 12 months.

The airline continues to target a return to operating profitability in 2027 and positive free cash flow in 2028. It expects another $250 million in aircraft-backed financing during the fourth quarter and is exploring additional funding sources, including its Paisly travel business , venture investments, and a co-branded credit-card partnership.

Those goals remain difficult to achieve. JetBlue lowered its 2026 adjusted operating-margin outlook after rising fuel costs weighed on its results. Its recovery depends on improving earnings while meeting substantial financing obligations over the coming years. Although creditor advisers may be preparing for potential negotiations, their involvement does not establish that restructuring is inevitable. For now, JetBlue maintains that it can finance its turnaround through available liquidity and additional funding options, while its lenders independently assess the risks surrounding repayment.

body_zh: 捷蓝航空的贷款公司聘请特别顾问应对 84 亿美元债务的偿还问题
Jack 带着对航空一切事物的终生兴趣加入了 Simple Flying。他拥有佐治亚理工学院的航空航天工程学位，并且是一名经过认证的私人和远程飞行员。除了这些经验之外，杰克还曾在公司飞行部门工作过，在那里他获得了公务航空领域的第一手经验。目前，杰克在专业服务行业工作，并在工作之外继续增加飞行时间。
由于人们越来越担心捷蓝航空管理债务和为扭亏为盈的能力提供资金，捷蓝航空的一群债权人已聘请财务顾问 PJT Partners 和律师事务所艾金岗普 (Akin Gump)。据报道，该集团包括持有约 20 亿美元 2031 年到期债券和 7.42 亿美元第一留置权贷款的投资者。这些任命表明贷款机构正在为潜在的谈判做准备，尽管这并不意味着捷蓝航空已申请破产或同意重组其义务。
该航空公司的更广泛债务和融资租赁义务总计约 84 亿美元。首席执行官乔安娜·杰拉蒂 (Joanna Geraghty) 10 月 27 日对路透社表示，捷蓝航空没有与债权人进行谈判，也没有考虑重组。她的言论是在该航空公司的债券大幅下跌之后发表的，引发了人们对其在不重新谈判借款安排的情况下恢复财务的能力的质疑。
捷蓝航空债券贬值，债权人聘请顾问

彭博社报道称，持有 20 亿美元债券发行和 7.42 亿美元贷款的捷蓝航空债权人正在与 PJT Partners 和艾金·岗波合作。报道曝光后，捷蓝航空和两家公司都没有公开证实这些任命。这种压力在捷蓝航空忠诚计划支持的 TrueBlue 高级担保票据中尤为明显。 10 月 26 日，发行的约 20 亿美元债券的交易价格约为 47 美分，低于本月初的约 80 美分。路透社援引伦敦证券交易所集团(LSEG)的数据显示，其收益率攀升至30%以上，反映出投资者对还款的担忧加剧。
债券价格下跌并不表明公司将违约。它们确实表明投资者认为还款风险比以前更大。债权人经常聘请重组专家来评估他们的选择，审查借款人的财务状况，并为可能的有关还款条款或抵押品的讨论做好准备。这些顾问代表贷款人，而不是捷蓝航空，他们的任命不会启动破产程序。
损失和燃油成本使航空公司的扭亏为盈变得复杂
债务担忧与持续的财务损失和更高的运营费用同时发生。该航空公司公布第三季度净亏损为 2.57 亿美元，而去年同期净亏损为 1.43 亿美元。 2026 年前 9 个月的净亏损几乎翻了一番，达到 8.23 亿美元，而第三季度燃油费用增长了 61%。然而，收入增长了 20% 以上，达到约 28 亿美元。
今年前 9 个月，该航空公司使用了 2.73 亿美元的运营现金，几乎是 2025 年同期的两倍。截至 9 月底，不受限制的现金和投资减少了约 8.5 亿美元，至 16 亿美元。其营运资本赤字也扩大至 16 亿美元，而 2025 年底为 12 亿美元。
捷蓝航空报告称，其流动性为 22 亿美元，还有约 70 亿美元的资产尚未抵押给贷方。然而，按账面价值计算，其拥有的财产、设备和无形资产中约三分之二已被抵押作为抵押品，限制了可用于获得额外融资的资产。根据该航空公司向美国证券交易委员会提交的第三季度文件，该航空公司还面临 2027 年 4.77 亿美元、2028 年 5.82 亿美元和 2029 年 18 亿美元的预定债务和融资租赁偿还。
捷蓝航空拒绝重组猜测并维持复苏目标
杰拉蒂试图让该航空公司远离有关潜在重组的猜测。她在接受路透社采访时表示，捷蓝航空没有与债权人进行谈判，无意申请破产，也没有寻求美国政府的财务支持。管理层坚称，公司有足够的流动性来满足至少未来 12 个月的需求。
该航空公司继续目标是在 2027 年恢复运营盈利，并在 2028 年实现正自由现金流。预计第四季度将再获得 2.5 亿美元的飞机支持融资，并正在探索其他资金来源，包括其 Paisly 旅行业务、风险投资和联合品牌信用卡合作伙伴关系。
这些目标仍然难以实现。由于燃油成本上涨影响了其业绩，捷蓝航空下调了 2026 年调整后营业利润率预期。其复苏取决于盈利的改善，同时满足未来几年的大量融资义务。尽管债权人顾问可能正在为潜在的谈判做准备，但他们的参与并不表明重组是不可避免的。目前，捷蓝航空坚称，它可以通过可用的流动性和额外的融资选择来为其扭亏为盈提供资金，而其贷方则独立评估与还款相关的风险。

title_en: United Airlines’ JFK Return Is Imminent: What’s The Strategy, Though?
title_zh: 联合航空重返肯尼迪机场迫在眉睫：策略是什么？
summary: United says it's on track to return to JFK in 2027, but between slot uncertainty, a crowded transcon market, and Delta's ground product, the strategy still isn't clear.
summary_zh: 美联航表示，它有望在 2027 年重返肯尼迪机场，但由于航班时刻的不确定性、拥挤的转运市场以及达美航空的地面产品，该战略
body_en: We know that United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby thinks that one of the carrier’s biggest mistakes in the past was pulling out of New York Kennedy Airport (JFK). He’s committed to changing that, and the airline still seems to think that it’s on track to return to the airport in 2027.

A lot has changed since this was initially a big topic of conversation, including United seemingly no longer being interested in any sort of merger with JetBlue. So with United potentially within a year of returning to JFK, I’d like to talk a bit more about what that could look like, as I’m still not sure I fully understand the strategy.
Why United left JFK, and how the airline plans to return
United obviously has a huge hub at Newark Liberty Airport (EWR), and different airline executives have different takes as to the overlap in demand between Newark and Kennedy.

Through late 2015, United had a relatively small presence at JFK, with a majority of the service consisting of premium transcontinental flights to Los Angeles (LAX) and San Francisco (SFO), with a product that was branded as p.s. The airline operated these flights with specially configured, three cabin Boeing 757-200s.

However, in late 2015, the airline made the decision to end service at JFK , and instead consolidate flights at EWR. The airline was reportedly losing money on these flights, and just couldn’t compete with American and Delta, which both had major hubs there.

Shortly after that decision was made, Kirby joined United, before eventually being appointed CEO . For as long as he has been at United, Kirby has felt that leaving JFK was one of the carrier’s biggest strategic blunders. In 2021, United briefly returned to JFK , operating transcon routes with Boeing 767-300ERs. However, the airline pulled out by 2022 , as it couldn’t get permanent slots, and couldn’t scale service in a way that made sense.

Ever since, United has been determined to return to JFK. We know that United wants up to 20 daily slot pairs at the airport, to offer very frequent coast-to-coast service. So, where do things stand? As flagged by JonNYC , United Chief Commercial Officer Andrew Nocella recently went on record to confirm that United is on track to return to JFK in 2027, which is just around the corner.
So, how will United secure the slots needed for service?

We know that JetBlue and United have their Blue Sky partnership , and that includes the possibility of JetBlue giving United up to seven daily slot pairs at JFK as early as 2027 (with “up to” and “as early as” being the key terms here)

United is reportedly exploring opportunities to acquire slot pairs from low margin carriers that aren’t doing well at JFK; however, those are unlikely to be very lucrative in terms of the timing of flights
I still have a hard time envisioning United’s JFK return

United management is generally on top of things when it comes to strategy, and I can make sense of most things. However, I still struggle to fully rationalize the plans for returning to JFK. That’s not to say it doesn’t make sense, or that I’m right, but here’s how I think through this

I struggle to see how JetBlue is getting sufficient upside from its partnership with United that it thinks it makes sense to give or trade seven slot pairs with United, just so that United can compete directly in two of JetBlue’s highest revenue markets

Even if United managed to secure 20 daily slot pairs for premium transcontinental routes, how will the airline do that without hemorrhaging money in the market? The airline is at a disadvantage in terms of customer loyalty at JFK, has more limited connecting traffic on the JFK side, etc. (though admittedly it’s better positioned on the West Coast)
I have to imagine that a major incentive with a return to JFK is being able to compete for Asia-bound traffic via the SFO hub, so the route could be used to fill connecting transpacific flights
How will United compete with the ground experience offered by competitors, when you have Delta offering a dedicated Delta One check-in facility, Delta One Lounge, etc.?

On the surface, entering a market as a fourth place player, with limited opportunity to grow, little connectivity on the JFK side, and limited ability to have a great ground experience, seems like it could create a challenge.

United Airlines executives still insist the airline will return to JFK in 2027. This seems to involve getting some number of slots from JetBlue (as part of their partnership), and then possibly acquiring slots from some other carriers. It’s still not entirely clear how this will play out, though last we heard, the goal is to get 20 slot pairs, and aggressively fly to LAX and SFO.

I know Kirby thinks it was a big mistake to leave JFK, though I remain a bit confused by how the airline offering high frequency service from JFK to the West Coast, when the markets are already served by three large carriers, will be lucrative.
body_zh: 我们知道，联合航空首席执行官斯科特·柯比（Scott Kirby）认为，该航空公司过去犯下的最大错误之一就是撤出纽约肯尼迪机场（JFK）。他致力于改变这一现状，而该航空公司似乎仍然认为 2027 年重返机场有望实现。
自从这最初成为一个大话题以来，很多事情都发生了变化，包括联合航空似乎不再对与捷蓝航空进行任何形式的合并感兴趣。因此，鉴于曼联可能在一年内重返肯尼迪国际机场，我想多谈谈这可能会是什么样子，因为我仍然不确定我是否完全理解这一战略。
美联航为何离开肯尼迪机场，以及该航空公司计划如何回归
联合航空显然在纽瓦克自由机场 (EWR) 拥有一个巨大的枢纽，不同的航空公司高管对于纽瓦克和肯尼迪之间的需求重叠有不同的看法。
到 2015 年底，美联航在肯尼迪机场的业务相对较少，其大部分服务包括飞往洛杉矶 (LAX) 和旧金山 (SFO) 的高级跨大陆航班，其产品品牌为 p.s.该航空公司使用专门配置的三舱波音 757-200 执飞这些航班。
然而，在 2015 年底，该航空公司决定终止在肯尼迪机场的服务，并合并在 EWR 的航班。据报道，该航空公司在这些航班上亏损，无法与美国航空和达美航空竞争，这两家航空公司都在那里设有主要枢纽。
该决定做出后不久，柯比加入了曼联，并最终被任命为首席执行官。柯比在曼联任职以来，一直认为离开肯尼迪机场是该航空公司最大的战略错误之一。 2021 年，美联航短暂返回肯尼迪机场，使用波音 767-300ER 运营转机航线。然而，该航空公司在 2022 年退出，因为它无法获得永久航班时刻，并且无法以有意义的方式扩展服务。
从那时起，曼联就决心重返肯尼迪机场。我们知道，美联航希望机场每天有多达 20 对航班时刻，以提供非常频繁的东西海岸航班服务。那么，情况如何呢？正如 JonNYC 所指出的那样，美联航首席商务官安德鲁·诺切拉 (Andrew Nocella) 最近公开证实，美联航有望于 2027 年重返肯尼迪机场，而这已经指日可待。
那么，美联航将如何确保服务所需的航班时刻呢？
我们知道捷蓝航空和美联航有蓝天合作伙伴关系，其中捷蓝航空有可能最早于 2027 年在肯尼迪机场为美联航提供最多 7 个每日航班时刻对（其中“最多”和“最早”是此处的关键术语）
据报道，美联航正在寻找机会从在肯尼迪机场表现不佳的低利润航空公司那里收购航班时刻对；然而，就航班时间而言，这些不太可能非常有利可图
我仍然很难想象曼联重返肯尼迪机场
在战略方面，曼联管理层通常是最重要的，我能理解大多数事情。然而，我仍然在努力使返回肯尼迪机场的计划完全合理化。这并不是说它没有意义，或者我是对的，但这就是我的想法
我很难看出捷蓝航空如何从与美联航的合作中获得足够的优势，以至于它认为与美联航提供或交易七个航班时刻对是有意义的，这样美联航就可以在捷蓝航空收入最高的两个市场中直接竞争
即使美联航成功地获得了 20 个每日优质横贯大陆航线的航班时刻对，该航空公司将如何在不损失市场资金的情况下做到这一点？该航空公司在肯尼迪机场的客户忠诚度方面处于劣势，肯尼迪机场一侧的转机交通更加有限等等（尽管不可否认，它在西海岸的定位更好）
我不得不想象，返回肯尼迪机场的一个主要动机是能够竞争通过 SFO 枢纽飞往亚洲的航班，因此该航线可用于填补跨太平洋转机航班
当达美航空提供专门的达美一号登机设施、达美一号休息室等时，美联航将如何与竞争对手提供的地面体验竞争？
从表面上看，以第四名球员的身份进入市场，成长机会有限，肯尼迪机场方面的联系很少，并且获得良好地面体验的能力有限，这似乎可能会带来挑战。
联合航空高管仍然坚称该公司将于 2027 年重返肯尼迪机场。这似乎涉及从捷蓝航空获得一些航班时刻（作为其合作伙伴关系的一部分），然后可能从其他一些航空公司获得航班时刻。目前尚不完全清楚这将如何进行，尽管我们上次听说，目标是获得 20 个时段对，并积极飞往洛杉矶国际机场和旧金山国际机场。
我知道柯比认为离开肯尼迪机场是一个很大的错误，尽管我仍然有点困惑，当市场已经由三大航空公司提供服务时，提供从肯尼迪机场到西海岸的高频服务的航空公司将如何利润丰厚。

title_en: Which Credit Card Should You Use For Marriott Hotel Stays? Here’s The Math
title_zh: 入住万豪酒店应使用哪张信用卡？这是数学
summary: Should you pay for Marriott stays with a co-branded Bonvoy card or a card earning bonus travel points? Here's the math behind which card gives the best return.
summary_zh: 您应该使用联名 Bonvoy 卡还是赚取奖励旅行积分的卡来支付万豪住宿费用？这是哪张卡给出最佳效果背后的数学原理
body_en: When you’re staying at a Marriott property, what’s the best credit card to use to maximize your return on Marriott hotel spending? Should you use a co-branded Marriott credit card, or are you better off using another credit card offering bonus points on travel? This is a question that comes up every so often, so I’d like to address it in this post…
Best credit card to use for Marriott hotel stays

I’ve written in the past about the best credit cards to use for hotel stays . However, more specifically to Marriott, which credit card should you put all of your Marriott spending on? Let’s take a look at the various approaches that you can take.

Let me start by acknowledging that we all value points currencies differently, so you should apply your own valuation to the math. My below analysis is based on my own valuation of various points currencies .

I also want to emphasize that the credit card you use won’t impact your ability to earn elite qualifying nights, take advantage of elite perks, and accrue the standard points that you can earn with the Marriott Bonvoy program. The credit card rewards offered when paying for your Marriott hotel stay are incremental.
The value of using a co-branded Marriott credit card

Marriott has co-branded credit cards in the United States that are issued by both American Express and Chase. All of these credit cards with annual fees have the same rewards structure for Marriott spending, as they offer 6x Bonvoy points on all eligible Marriott spending.

This includes cards like the Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card ( learn more ), Marriott Bonvoy Business® American Express® Card ( learn more ), and Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant® American Express® Card ( learn more ), just to name a few. Personally, I value Bonvoy points at 0.7 cents each, so to me these cards offer an incremental 4.2% return on that spending.

I think the one thing worth pointing out is that the Marriott Bonvoy Bevy® American Express® Card offers 1,000 Bonvoy bonus points per Marriott stay when paying with the card, in addition to the rewards that you usually earn.

Technically that would be the best co-branded card for Marriott spending, since you earn 6x points, plus 1,000 bonus points per stay. That being said, I’d otherwise consider this to be one of the less compelling Marriott cards in terms of the overall value proposition.
I generally recommend putting most of your spending on cards earning transferable points currencies , given that they offer the most flexible rewards, and also have excellent bonus categories.

I’d argue that the two best cards for hotel spending are the Chase Sapphire Reserve® Card ( learn more ) and Sapphire Reserve for Business℠ ( learn more ), as they offer 4x transferable points for direct hotel purchases. Since I value Ultimate Rewards points at 1.7 cents each, that’s like a 6.8% return on that spending, which is excellent.

It’s worth noting that there are other cards earning 3x points on hotels, like the Citi Strata Premier® Card ( learn more ), and I’d value that at a return of 5.1%. Lastly, the Wells Fargo Autograph Journey Card ( learn more ) actually offers 5x points on hotel purchases, which is excellent, though I don’t value those points as much as other transferable points currencies.

Personally, the Chase Sapphire Reserve and Sapphire Reserve Business are my go-to cards for hotel spending. Simply put, I can’t turn down 4x Ultimate Rewards points, in comparison to earning 6x Bonvoy points with the Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant Amex for my Marriott spending.

The difference in math is just too great, since I value 4x Ultimate Rewards points at way more than 6x Bonvoy points. But this also brings me to a related topic of how points valuations sometimes don’t dictate my consumer behavior. For example, back in the day, the Chase Sapphire Reserve offered 3x Ultimate Rewards points on hotel spending.

So I valued that at offering a 5.1% return, rather than a 4.2% return on a Marriott credit card. Despite that, I’d use a co-branded Marriott card for my Marriott spending. Why? Well, this gets at a consideration that’s hard to factor into my valuation of points. I’m talking about the ease of earning various points currencies.

I can earn transferable points currencies in all kinds of ways, including with my everyday spending. However, there aren’t many ways to efficiently earn Bonvoy points, short of staying at Marriott properties. As I often talk about when sharing my points strategy, there’s merit to collecting points that are harder to earn, even if they’re not the points currency that you necessarily value the most. This was one of those cases, at least for me. However, with the Chase Sapphire Reserve nowadays earning 4x points per dollar spent on hotels, my logic on that has evolved.
Everyone has their own credit card strategy, and at times it can be tough to decide which card is the best for a particular spending category.

In the case of spending at Marriott properties, I’d argue that the Chase Sapphire Reserve and Sapphire Reserve Business are nowadays the most lucrative, given that they offer 4x Ultimate Rewards points on that spending, which I value at a 6.8% return. I’d say that beats the Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant Amex , offering 6x Bonvoy points, which I value at a 4.2% return.

body_zh: 当您入住万豪酒店时，最适合使用哪张信用卡来最大限度地提高万豪酒店消费回报？您应该使用万豪联名信用卡，还是使用另一张提供旅行奖励积分的信用卡会更好？这是一个经常出现的问题，所以我想在这篇文章中解决这个问题......
入住万豪酒店的最佳信用卡
我过去写过有关用于酒店住宿的最佳信用卡的文章。然而，更具体地说，对于万豪来说，您应该将所有万豪支出都放在哪张信用卡上？让我们看看您可以采取的各种方法。
首先我要承认，我们对点货币的估值不同，因此您应该将自己的估值应用到数学中。我的以下分析是基于我自己对各种积分货币的估值。
我还想强调的是，您使用的信用卡不会影响您赚取精英资格住宿、利用精英福利以及通过万豪旅享家计划赚取标准积分的能力。支付万豪酒店住宿费用时提供的信用卡奖励是递增的。
使用万豪联名信用卡的价值
万豪在美国拥有由美国运通卡和大通银行发行的联名信用卡。所有这些年费信用卡对于万豪消费都具有相同的奖励结构，因为它们为所有符合条件的万豪消费提供 6 倍 Bonvoy 积分。
其中包括万豪旅享家 Bevy® 美国运通® 卡（了解更多）、万豪旅享家商务® 美国运通® 卡（了解更多）和万豪旅享家 Brilliant® 美国运通® 卡（了解更多）等卡。就我个人而言，我认为 Bonvoy 积分的价值为每个 0.7 美分，因此对我来说，这些卡可提供 4.2% 的增量回报。
我认为值得指出的一件事是，万豪旅享家 Bevy® 美国运通® 卡除了您通常赚取的奖励外，每次万豪住宿付款还可获得 1,000 点旅享家奖励积分。
从技术上讲，这将是万豪消费的最佳联名卡，因为您可以赚取 6 倍积分，并且每次住宿还可获得 1,000 点奖励积分。话虽这么说，但就总体价值主张而言，我认为这是不太引人注目的万豪卡之一。
我通常建议将大部分支出放在可赚取可转让积分货币的卡上，因为它们提供最灵活的奖励，并且还具有出色的奖励类别。
我认为最适合酒店消费的两张卡是 Chase Sapphire Reserve® 卡（了解更多）和 Sapphire Reserve for Business℠（了解更多），因为它们为直接酒店消费提供 4 倍可转让积分。由于我对终极奖励积分的估值为每个 1.7 美分，因此该支出的回报率为 6.8%，非常好。
值得注意的是，还有其他卡可以在酒店赚取 3 倍积分，例如 Citi Strata Premier® 卡（了解更多），我认为它的回报率为 5.1%。最后，富国银行签名旅行卡（了解更多）实际上在酒店购物时提供 5 倍积分，这非常好，尽管我不像其他可转让积分货币那样重视这些积分。
就我个人而言，Chase Sapphire Reserve 和 Sapphire Reserve Business 是我酒店消费的首选卡。简而言之，与使用 Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant Amex 为我的万豪消费赚取 6 倍 Bonvoy 积分相比，我无法拒绝 4 倍终极奖励积分。
数学上的差异太大了，因为我更看重 4 倍终极奖励积分，远高于 6 倍 Bonvoy 积分。但这也让我想到了一个相关的话题：积分估值有时并不决定我的消费行为。例如，当时，Chase Sapphire Reserve 提供酒店消费 3 倍终极奖励积分。
因此，我认为提供 5.1% 的回报率，而不是万豪信用卡 4.2% 的回报率。尽管如此，我还是会使用万豪联名卡进行万豪消费。为什么？嗯，这是一个很难纳入我的积分评估的考虑因素。我说的是赚取各种积分货币的容易程度。
我可以通过各种方式赚取可转让积分货币，包括通过日常消费。然而，除了入住万豪酒店之外，有效赚取旅享家积分的方法并不多。正如我在分享积分策略时经常谈到的那样，收集较难赚取的积分是有好处的，即使它们不是您最看重的积分货币。这就是其中之一，至少对我来说是这样。然而，如今，随着 Chase Sapphire Reserve 在酒店每消费 1​​ 美元即可赚取 4 倍积分，我的逻辑已经发生了变化。
每个人都有自己的信用卡策略，有时很难决定哪张卡最适合特定的消费类别。
就万豪酒店的消费而言，我认为 Chase Sapphire Reserve 和 Sapphire Reserve Business 是目前最赚钱的，因为它们为该消费提供 4 倍终极奖励积分，我认为其回报率为 6.8%。我想说这比提供 6 倍 Bonvoy 积分的 Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant Amex 更好，我认为它的回报率为 4.2%。

body_en: Iberia adds 98 Andalusia flights following rail accident, caps Economy fares at €99 - Aviation24.be
Home International Airlines Group (IAG) Iberia Iberia adds 98 Andalusia flights following rail accident, caps Economy fares at...
Iberia and Iberia Express have scheduled 98 additional flights between Madrid and Andalusia through 8 November, responding to increased demand following the rail accident in Urda , Toledo.

The airlines say they have added 20,718 seats, increasing capacity by 93% against the original schedule. Madrid–Seville accounts for 10,734 extra seats and Madrid–Málaga for 9,984. Iberia will operate 78 of the additional flights, and Iberia Express will operate the remaining 20.

For the All Saints’ Day holiday period through Monday, the group has scheduled 34 extra flights and 7,642 additional seats across the two routes. The airline is also deploying larger aircraft on selected existing services.

Until 8 November, fares between Madrid and Andalusia are capped at €99 per one-way segment in Economy and €149 in Business. Booking flexibility is available for passengers affected by the rail accident. Iberia is also working on additional flights from 9 November, although these have not yet been scheduled.

Four military personnel have reportedly died and 11 others were injured after an Italian Army Boeing CH-47 Chinook operating with EUFOR Althea crashed near Gorica, in Bosnia and Herzegovina’s Br?ko district, on 29 October 2026.
EUFOR confirmed that one of its aircraft crashed during a routine operation and said no civilian infrastructure was damaged. Rescue teams were dispatched immediately.

Initial reporting by ANSA, citing Br?ko Mayor Siniša Mili?, put the toll at three dead and 12 injured. The supplied Dutch-language report subsequently quoted Br?ko hospital spokesperson Salih Ibrahimbegovi? as saying a fourth serviceman had died in hospital. The reports indicate that 15 people were aboard; their nationalities have not been confirmed.

The cause remains under investigation. EUFOR said it would conduct a full investigation and release further information once the facts had been established, urging the public to avoid circulating unverified claims.

title_en: Passenger rights group sues DOT over rule shifting flight delay costs to travelers
title_zh: 乘客权利组织起诉交通部将航班延误费用转嫁给旅客的规定
summary: Airline passenger group FlyersRights is suing the US Department of Transportation (DOT) over a rule it says shifts… The post Passenger rights group sues DOT over rule shifting flight delay costs to travelers appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 航空公司乘客权利组织 FlyersRights 正在起诉美国交通部 (DOT)，其声称其规则发生了变化……
body_en: Airline passenger group FlyersRights is suing the US Department of Transportation (DOT) over a rule it says shifts the cost of meals, hotels and other expenses from airlines to passengers during flight delays and cancellations.

The group announced the court action on October 30, 2026, saying it had filed a petition in the US Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. It argues that the DOT went beyond what Congress authorized and improperly adopted the rule without first seeking public comment.

The rule changes how airlines report the causes of delays and cancellations. Ten types of disruption, including certain unscheduled maintenance and cybersecurity attacks, would move out of the “Air Carrier” category used for problems deemed within an airline’s control. The DOT says the exclusions were required by the FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024.

FlyersRights says the distinction could have consequences for passengers whose flights are disrupted. Airline promises to provide meals, hotel rooms and transportation often depend on whether the cause was within the carrier’s control.
The DOT acknowledged in the rule that it expects airlines to provide less in amenities and compensation once the 10 causes are excluded from the airline-controlled category.
“A change in reporting classifications is not permission to reduce passenger rights,” FlyersRights President Paul Hudson said in the group’s announcement of its court petition.

The maintenance provision of the DOT rule covers problems arising outside scheduled maintenance that cannot be deferred or must be addressed before flight, including work required by an airworthiness directive.

Other exclusions include removing an unruly passenger, medical emergencies that are not the airline’s fault and unexpected failures of government systems. Cyberattacks qualify only when the airline complies with applicable cybersecurity regulations.

FlyersRights says Congress told DOT to change how airlines report the causes of delays, not reduce their responsibility to help stranded passengers. It says an airline’s selection of a reporting code should not determine whether it owes a stranded traveler assistance.

The group also disputes the DOT’s decision to skip the usual public notice-and-comment process. FlyersRights and three other consumer organizations previously asked the department to withdraw the rule.
The changes have not yet taken effect. The DOT published the rule on September 3, 2026, but later postponed its effective date to February 1, 2027, following a request from Airlines for America.
The revised reporting requirements will cover flights beginning January 1, 2027. The DOT said the additional time would allow airlines and the government to update their reporting systems.

Ticket refunds are separate from the meals, lodging and other assistance at issue. Under DOT rules, passengers are entitled to a refund when an airline cancels their flight, regardless of the reason, and they decline alternative travel, vouchers or other compensation. Refund rights also apply to qualifying significant delays and schedule changes when passengers choose not to travel.
The post Passenger rights group sues DOT over rule shifting flight delay costs to travelers appeared first on AeroTime .
body_zh: 航空客运集团 FlyersRights 正在起诉美国交通部 (DOT)，因为美国交通部称，在航班延误和取消期间，将膳食、酒店和其他费用从航空公司转移给乘客。
该组织于 2026 年 10 月 30 日宣布了法院诉讼，称已向美国哥伦比亚特区巡回上诉法院提交请愿书。它认为交通部超出了国会的授权范围，并且在没有首先征求公众意见的情况下不适当地采用了该规则。
该规则改变了航空公司报告延误和取消原因的方式。十种类型的中断，包括某些计划外的维护和网络安全攻击，将脱离“航空承运人”类别，用于解决航空公司控制范围内的问题。 DOT 表示，这些排除是根据 2024 年 FAA 重新授权法案的要求进行的。
FlyersRights 表示，这种区别可能会对航班中断的乘客产生影响。航空公司承诺提供餐食、酒店房间和交通通常取决于原因是否在航空公司的控制范围内。
美国交通部在规则中承认，一旦这 10 种原因被排除在航空公司控制的类别之外，预计航空公司将减少提供的便利设施和补偿。
FlyersRights 总裁保罗·哈德森 (Paul Hudson) 在该组织向法庭请愿的声明中表示：“报告分类的变化并不意味着允许减少乘客的权利。”
DOT 规则的维护规定涵盖了定期维护之外出现的不能推迟或必须在飞行前解决的问题，包括适航指令要求的工作。
其他除外情况包括驱逐不守规矩的乘客、非航空公司过错的医疗紧急情况以及政府系统的意外故障。仅当航空公司遵守适用的网络安全法规时，网络攻击才符合资格。
FlyersRights 表示，国会要求交通部改变航空公司报告延误原因的方式，而不是减少他们帮助滞留乘客的责任。它表示，航空公司选择的报告代码不应决定其是否欠滞留旅客援助。
该组织还对交通部跳过通常的公众通知和评论程序的决定提出异议。 FlyersRights 和其他三个消费者组织此前曾要求该部门撤销该规定。
这些更改尚未生效。美国交通部于 2026 年 9 月 3 日发布了该规则，但后来应美国航空公司的要求将其生效日期推迟至 2027 年 2 月 1 日。
修订后的报告要求将涵盖 2027 年 1 月 1 日开始的航班。交通部表示，额外的时间将使航空公司和政府能够更新其报告系统。
机票退款与相关的餐食、住宿和其他帮助是分开的。根据交通部的规定，当航空公司取消航班时，无论出于何种原因，乘客都有权获得退款，并且他们拒绝替代旅行、代金券或其他补偿。当乘客选择不旅行时，退款权利也适用于符合资格的重大延误和时间表变更。
乘客权利组织就将航班延误费用转嫁给旅客的规则起诉交通部，该消息首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

This contract includes options, which if exercised, would bring the maximum contract value to $49,990,000. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N00039-17-D-0003). body_en: Autoflight V5000 Matrix william.moore@… Tue, 03/31/2026 - 07:48 The V5000 Matrix is a lift-plus-cruise hybrid-electric/all-electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft being developed by AutoFlight Europe GmbH. Unveiled in February 2026, the aircraft performed a remotely piloted transition from thrustborne hover to wingborne cruise, demonstrating that flight testing is already underway. Industry commentators have suggested that entry into service could be as soon as 2027/2028, although there is no confirmation of this. Certification is to be sought from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) under powered-lift regulations. Structure and Powertrain The Matrix pushes regulations to their maximum, being a 10 seat eVTOL with a maximum take-off weight of 5,700kg (hybrid version). The aircraft could be configured in a 6-seat VIP layout, or a 9-seat business layout plus a pilot. It will also feature a lavatory, the first eVTOL design to incorporate this, an indication of its lengthier flight duration capabilities. An uncrewed cargo variant is also in development. The intended market is more regional-focused than previous eVTOL designs. Structurally, the V5000 is an evolution of the previous Autoflight Prosperity I and CarryAll cargo variant. It features a long, aerodynamic cabin with panoramic viewing windows and skid-style landing gear. A main high wing is complemented by two smaller wings to the front and rear of the aircraft, with three booms extending across all three wings parallel to the cabin, on each side. 20 two-blade fixed propellers are mounted to the six booms to provide lift, while eight cruise propellers provide forward thrust, four mounted to the front and four to the rear. body_en: Turkey Signs $11 Billion Eurofighter Deal hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:19 Turkey has signed a long-anticipated £8 billion ($11 billion) deal to acquire Eurofighter Typhoons, the first major export contract for the four-nation combat aircraft since 2017. Twenty new-built aircraft will be purchased in the country’s first acquisition of a European combat aircraft after decades of operating new and secondhand U.S.-built fighters. But Turkey’s Eurofighter order could more than double in size, according to Turkish Defense Minister Yasar Guler. He declared that Ankara would also buy another 24 aircraft second hand, 12 each from Oman and Qatar. If those sales go through, Oman would be giving up Eurofighter operations. With deliveries of the new-build aircraft not due until 2030, delivering those second-hand aircraft—potentially as early as next year from Qatar, according to Guler—would allow Turkey to accelerate the Eurofighter’s entry into service and enable the retirement of older aircraft from its inventory, including the McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom. BAE Systems, which will produce the newly built aircraft in Warton, England, says it will receive £5.4 billion of the £8 billion deal. Included in the £5.4 billion are the aircraft and the weapons package from MBDA, including some integration work, potentially for Turkish indigenous weaponry. The remaining £2.6 billion is support and training activity, which will be contracted later, BAE Systems officials say. It is unclear whether the deal will ultimately include offsets to enable Turkish industry to become involved in the Eurofighter program and for Turkey to have a level of freedom of action for the fleet. After decades of facing numerous arms embargoes, Turkey often demands the ability to locally perform airframe, system and engine maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) in-country. The deal was struck during a meeting between UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Ankara. Starmer said the deal was a win for British workers and the wider UK defense industry. Government officials claim the order is “saving the Warton production line,” after concerns about a lack of new orders for UK-built Typhoons were expressed by workers unions. UK industry has a 37% share in the Eurofighter program and production of major component assemblies is being ramped up thanks to orders from the other Eurofighter partner nations including Germany, Italy and Spain. “Today’s announcement extends Typhoon production and preserves crucial sovereign skills which underpin the UK’s defense and security,” BAE Systems CEO Charles Woodburn said. The deal is another major boost for the UK defense industry, coming just weeks after the UK’s Type 26 frigates were selected by Norway in a £10 billion deal. UK Defense Secretary John Healey said the deal went beyond the procurement of aircraft. “It is the leading edge of the growing defense and industrial partnership between our two nations,” he said. As part of the visit, Starmer also visited the facilities of Turkish Aerospace Industries, where he was shown the indigenous Kaan combat aircraft. He was also exposed to the Hurjet advanced jet trainer, a potential candidate to replace the BAE Systems Hawk jet trainer in the UK Royal Air Force (RAF) inventory. The deal follows three years of negotiations, which have included lobbying of the German government for Berlin to lift a restriction on a Eurofighter sale after Erdoğan’s government arrested Istanbul Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu, who is seen as a serious presidential rival to Erdoğan in upcoming elections. The administration of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz lifted the sanctions in part because of the benefit to German industry. A memorandum of understanding between the UK and Turkish governments for a Eurofighter sale was agreed to in July. Turkey’s interest in the aircraft is driven in part by a need for a more capable air combat platform to be available in the interim until advanced versions of the Kaan aircraft are produced in the 2030s. Ankara’s decision to opt for a European fighter, meanwhile, will have been driven by a need to diversify sources of supply after facing sanctions from the U.S. over its purchase of a Russian air defense system and banishment from the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter program. The transfer of Omani and Qatari aircraft to Turkey begs questions over the future of additional Eurofighter orders from Qatar, which has long been linked to orders for a further 12 aircraft for a total of 36. Oman, meanwhile, appears to want to consolidate its fighter fleet around the Lockheed Martin F-16 Block 50. In BAE Systems’ 2023 full-year results, the company revealed that the Omani air force had chosen not to renew support arrangements for its Typhoons, and it is unclear how active that fleet now is. Buying these additional aircraft would mean Turkey would have a mix of three configurations in its fleet. Qatar’s aircraft have the Mk.0 version of the active electronically scanned array European Common Radar System (ECRS) radar, while Oman’s feature the mechanically scanned Captor sensor. In addition to the Eurofighter order, Erdoğan and Starmer also revealed they were working on a new trade and security pact. 亿英镑用于支持和培训活动，稍后将签订合同。目前尚不清楚该协议最终是否会包括补偿，以使土耳其工业能够参与欧洲战斗机计划，并使土耳其机队拥有一定程度的行动自由。在经历了数十年的多次武器禁运后，土耳其经常要求能够在国内进行机身、系统和发动机维护、修理和大修 (MRO)。该协议是在英国首相基尔·斯塔默和土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安在安卡拉会晤期间达成的。斯塔默表示，这笔交易对英国工人和更广泛的英国国防工业来说是一场胜利。在工会表达了对英国制造的台风战机缺乏新订单的担忧后，政府官员声称该订单正在“拯救沃顿生产线”。英国工业在欧洲战斗机项目中占有 37% 的份额，并且由于德国、意大利和西班牙等其他欧洲战斗机伙伴国家的订单，主要零部件组件的生产正在增加。 BAE Systems 首席执行官查尔斯·伍德伯恩 (Charles Woodburn) 表示：“今天的公告延长了台风战机的生产，并保留了支撑英国国防和安全的关键主权技能。”这笔交易是英国国防工业的又一重大推动力，就在几周前，挪威在一笔价值 100 亿英镑的交易中选择了英国 26 型护卫舰。英国国防部长约翰·希利表示，该交易超出了飞机采购范围。 “这是我们两国之间不断发展的国防和工业伙伴关系的前沿，”他说。作为访问的一部分，斯塔默还参观了土耳其航空航天工业公司的设施，在那里他参观了本土的卡恩战斗机。他还接触了 Hurjet 高级喷气教练机，该教练机是英国皇家空军 (RAF) 库存中 BAE Systems Hawk 喷气教练机的潜在替代者。该协议经过了三年的谈判，其中包括在埃尔多安政府逮捕了伊斯坦布尔市长埃克雷姆·伊马莫格鲁后，游说德国政府要求柏林解除对欧洲战斗机销售的限制，后者被视为埃尔多安在即将举行的选举中的严重总统竞争对手。德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨(Friedrich Merz)政府取消了制裁，部分原因是这对德国工业有利。英国和土耳其政府于 7 月就欧洲战斗机销售达成了一份谅解备忘录。土耳其对这款飞机的兴趣部分是因为在 2030 年代生产出先进版本的卡恩飞机之前，需要在过渡期间提供更强大的空战平台。与此同时，安卡拉决定选择欧洲战斗机，是因为在因购买俄罗斯防空系统而面临美国制裁以及被排除在 F-35 联合攻击战斗机计划之外后，供应来源多样化的需要。阿曼和卡塔尔飞机向土耳其的转移引发了人们对卡塔尔额外欧洲战斗机订单未来的疑问，长期以来，卡塔尔的欧洲战斗机订单一直与另外 12 架飞机的订单有关，总计 36 架。与此同时，阿曼似乎希望以洛克希德·马丁公司的 F-16 Block 50 为中心巩固其战斗机机队。在 BAE Systems 的 2023 年全年业绩中，该公司透露，阿曼空军已选择不为其续签支持安排。台风，目前尚不清楚该舰队现在的活跃程度。购买这些额外的飞机意味着土耳其的机队将混合三种配置。卡塔尔的飞机配备了 Mk.0 版本的有源电子扫描阵列欧洲通用雷达系统 (ECRS) 雷达，而阿曼的飞机配备了机械扫描 Captor 传感器。除了欧洲战斗机订单外，埃尔多安和斯塔默还透露，他们正在制定一项新的贸易和安全协议。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 文章类型 文章 主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者托尼·奥斯本 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 从列表中排除？没有标签： 土耳其 、 欧洲战斗机台风 、 BAE 系统 、 MBDA 门控 ASD 特色图片 Typhoon_1600px.jpg title_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的秘密自主飞机“莲花计划”揭晓
summary: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototy
summary_zh: 莲花计划，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的秘密自主飞机揭晓 hockensmithawi…
body_en: Project Lotus, Northrop Grumman’s Secret Autonomous Aircraft Revealed hockensmithawi… Mon, 10/27/2025 - 18:05 Northrop Grumman has secretly built a large new uncrewed aircraft system (UAS), dubbed Project Lotus, at the company’s Scaled Composites rapid prototyping facility in Mojave, California, a source familiar with the project tells Aviation Week. A photo of the aircraft reviewed by Aviation Week revealed a completed, turbofan-powered aircraft parked within the Scaled Composites compound at the public airport. The Lotus UAS design in some ways resembles features of the newly revealed Lockheed Martin Project Vectis, with a long, slender fuselage positioned forward of the leading edges of the wings, capped by a nose with swept-back edges leading to a slender point. In many other respects, the Lotus and Vectis designs diverge. Unlike the engine inlet mounted low at mid-fuselage for the Vectis aircraft, the Lotus inlet sits high atop of the extreme aft section of its fuselage. The Lotus also sports sharply canted tails, breaking from the tailless-configured Vectis. Project Lotus appears to represent Northrop’s candidate for the U.S. Air Force’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) Increment 2 program, which is finalizing requirements for competitive prototypes ahead of a scheduled acquisition process next year. The photo reveals that Northrop has already built a demonstrator, perhaps gaining a step on Lockheed’s rival design, which is not scheduled to reach first flight until 2027. As Northrop’s rapid prototyping arm, the Scaled Composites facility frequently builds aircraft demonstrators in secret. Scaled Composites registered a turbofan-powered, fixed-wing aircraft identified only as Model 444 earlier this year with the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), which granted the organization the N444LX tail number. It is not clear if the registration represents Project Lotus or another undisclosed project. Northrop also is building the XRQ-73, also known as the Series Hybrid Electric Propulsion AiR Demonstration (Shepard), for DARPA. In response to questions about Project Lotus from Aviation Week, Northrop avoided direct answers, but spoke generally about its internal investments in autonomous aircraft. “Our investments prioritize production at speed and scale, without sacrificing performance or capability. The Northrop Grumman team has generated step-change advancements in production speed, weight and parts reduction, and overall cost efficiency. These advancements benefit the spectrum of autonomous capabilities we produce at Northrop Grumman for U.S. and international customers,” Northrop said. As Lockheed’s Project Vectis design revealed in September, Northrop’s Project Lotus represents one side in a long-running debate within industry and the Air Force over the future direction of the CCA fleet between concepts that emphasize greater survivability or lower cost. In 2024, the Air Force decided to seek a middle ground between cost and survivability with the selected competitive prototypes for the CCA Increment 1 program. The General Atomics Aeronautical Systems Inc. YFQ-42 and Anduril YFQ-44 are large aircraft that feature some low-observable, or stealth, technology. But the aircraft are larger and costlier than, for example, the Kratos XQ-58, and lack the stealthier features of Project Vectis and Project Lotus. In September, Air Force officials said they were considering the full spectrum of options for the Increment 2 CCA requirement, ranging from exquisite survivability to small, air-launched systems. Project Lotus also lends new insight into how Northrop’s internal CCA concepts have evolved from previous, publicly released ideas. As the Air Force competition for CCAs heated up in 2023, Northrop showed off the SG-1 and SG-2 concepts, which appeared similar to the cranked-kite planform of the U.S. Navy-funded X-47B demonstrator. Around the same time, Northrop also unveiled the Model 437 concept, an autonomous spinoff from the crewed Model 401 Sierra demonstrator. The Model 437 finally emerged as a piloted demonstrator aircraft in 2024. Earlier this year, Northrop announced that the aircraft had transitioned into the Beacon demonstrator, serving as a testbed for mission autonomy technology. body_zh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的莲花项目秘密揭晓 hockensmithawi…2025 年 10 月 27 日星期一 - 18:05 一位熟悉该项目的消息人士告诉《航空周刊》，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司已在该公司位于加利福尼亚州莫哈韦的规模化复合材料快速原型制造工厂秘密建造了一个大型新型无人驾驶飞机系统 (UAS)，称为“莲花项目”。 《航空周刊》查看的一张飞机照片显示，一架完工的涡轮风扇飞机停在公共机场的 Scaled Composites 园区内。莲花无人机的设计在某些方面类似于新推出的洛克希德·马丁公司 Vectis 项目的特征，其长而细长的机身位于机翼前缘的前面，其机头顶部有后掠边缘，通向细长的尖端。 Lotus 和 Vectis 的设计在许多其他方面存在差异。与 Vectis 飞机的发动机进气口安装在机身中部较低的位置不同，Lotus 进气口位于机身最后部的高处。 Lotus 还拥有急剧倾斜的尾部，与无尾配置的 Vectis 不同。 Lotus 项目似乎代表了诺斯罗普美国空军协同作战飞机 (CCA) Increment 2 计划的候选者，该计划将在明年预定的采购过程之前最终确定竞争性原型机的要求。这张照片显示，诺斯罗普公司已经制造了一架验证机，或许比洛克希德公司的竞争对手设计领先一步，后者预计要到 2027 年才能实现首飞。作为诺斯罗普公司的快速原型制造部门，Scaled Composites 工厂经常秘密制造飞机验证机。今年早些时候，Scaled Composites 向美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 注册了一架涡轮风扇动力固定翼飞机，型号为 444，并授予该组织 N444LX 尾号。目前尚不清楚该注册是否代表 Project Lotus 还是另一个未公开的项目。诺斯罗普还正在为 DARPA 建造 XRQ-73，也称为系列混合电动推进 AiR 演示（Shepard）。在回答《航空周刊》有关莲花项目的问题时，诺斯罗普避免直接回答，但笼统地谈到了其对自动驾驶飞机的内部投资。诺斯罗普表示：“我们的投资优先考虑速度和规模生产，而不牺牲性能或能力。诺斯罗普·格鲁曼团队在生产速度、重量和零件减少以及整体成本效率方面取得了巨大进步。这些进步有利于我们在诺斯罗普·格鲁曼为美国和国际客户生产的一系列自主能力。”正如洛克希德公司的 Vectis 项目设计在 9 月透露的那样，诺斯罗普的 Lotus 项目代表了工业界和空军内部关于 CCA 机队未来方向的长期争论中的一方，争论强调更高的生存能力或更低的成本。 2024 年，空军决定为 CCA Increment 1 计划选定具有竞争力的原型机，在成本和生存能力之间寻求中间立场。通用原子航空系统公司的 YFQ-42 和 Anduril YFQ-44 是大型飞机，采用一些低可观测或隐形技术。但该飞机比 Kratos XQ-58 等飞机更大、更昂贵，并且缺乏 Project Vectis 和 Project Lotus 的隐身功能。 9 月，空军官员表示，他们正在考虑满足 Increment 2 CCA 要求的全方位选择，从出色的生存能力到小型空射系统。 Lotus 项目还为诺斯罗普内部 CCA 概念如何从之前公开发布的想法演变而来提供了新的见解。随着 2023 年空军 CCA 竞争的白热化，诺斯罗普展示了 SG-1 和 SG-2 概念，它们看起来类似于美国海军资助的 X-47B 验证机的曲柄风筝平面图。大约在同一时间，诺斯罗普还推出了 Model 437 概念车，这是载人 Model 401 Sierra 验证机的自主衍生产品。 437 型最终于 2024 年成为有人驾驶验证机。今年早些时候，诺斯罗普宣布该飞机已转变为 Beacon 验证机，作为任务自主技术的测试平台。发行《航空航天日报与国防报告》，2025 年 10 月 28 日 《航空周刊与航天技术》，2025 年 11 月 10 日 文章类型 文章主要类别 飞机与推进系统 作者 Steve Trimble 内容来源 航空航天日报与国防报告 航空周刊与航天技术 从列表中排除？没有标签：UAS、洛克希德·马丁公司、诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司、协同作战飞机 (CCA) 门控 AWST-MRO ASD 特色图片 snapshot_2025-10-27_scaled_composites_from_gmaps.png 二级类别/子类别 航空航天防御飞机与推进系统 标题中是否有 iframe？关闭 知识中心特色内容 关闭 不呈现广告 关闭 暂时设置为 AWIN 免费增值 关闭

body_en: Second B-21 Enters Flight Test In Palmdale hockensmithawi… Thu, 09/11/2025 - 18:36 The B-21 Raider program completed the first flight of a second airborne test aircraft in Palmdale, California on Sept. 11, clearing a key milestone a month before the 10th anniversary of the U.S. Air Force contract award to Northrop Grumman. Witnesses posted video on social media showing the B-21 flight-test aircraft passing overhead with wheels retracted and followed by a Lockheed Martin F-16 chase plane. “We can now expedite critical evaluations of mission systems and weapons capabilities, directly supporting the strategic deterrence and combat effectiveness envisioned for this aircraft,” Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said. Northrop assembles all B-21s inside Building 401 on Site 4 of the Air Force’s Plant 42 complex at Palmdale Regional Airport. New test aircraft must fly out of the public airport after they have been assembled, before they can relocate to the secure area of nearby Edwards Air Force Base. The milestone comes nearly 22 months after Northrop completed the maiden sortie of the first flight test version of the B-21 on Nov. 10, 2023. The company has also delivered to the Air Force two more fully assembled airframes, which are reserved for static and fatigue testing on the ground. Two more flight-test aircraft have been in some stage of assembly since at least February 2022. Air Force officials say the program remains on track to clear the initial operational capability milestone in the mid-2020s. Northrop won the $21.4 billion contract in October 2015 for the engineering and manufacturing development phase of the Long-Range Strike Bomber, which the Air Force later rechristened as the B-21 Raider. The Air Force also signed orders with Northrop for the first two-year lots of low-rate initial production. title_en: South African Airways Delaying Staff Pay, Yet Insists Finances Are Fine
title_zh: 南非航空公司推迟员工工资，但坚称财务状况良好
summary: South African Airways reportedly can't pay 30-40% of its staff, blaming fuel costs and prioritizing operations, while insisting it won't seek a bailout. The finances raise questions.
summary_zh: 据报道，南非航空公司无法支付 30-40% 员工的工资，原因是燃油成本和优先运营，同时坚称不会寻求白楼
body_en: South African Airways (SAA) has had pretty consistent financial issues for the past 15 or so years. In 2021, the airline emerged from “business rescue” with a clean balance sheet (and as a shell of its former self), and it has sort of been chugging along ever since.

However, the airline once again seems to be in a dire situation, as a large percentage of staff aren’t being paid. It’s anyone’s guess how this plays out, though executives at the company insist everything is fine.
South African Airways downplays financial issues

South African Airways is reportedly unable to pay 30-40% of its staff at the moment, claiming it has to prioritize critical operational costs. The airline is deferring salaries of management, pilots, executives, and board members, blaming the situation in rising fuel prices.

The company’s head of corporate affairs, Mpilo Dlamini, explained that SAA has struggled with insufficient capital injections since emerging from business rescue, though insists the airline won’t seek a bailout

“After the business rescue process, we did not get enough capital injection that is going to keep us afloat, cushion our costs, make sure that we expand the way we wanted to expand. So, there are those issues that I want to admit made us, you know, to be affected in terms of liquidity.”

“The board and the management are seized with making sure that we are actually the support that we got from government through the guarantee. We are talking and engaging a number of our financial institutions, and I must say and confirm to you now that they are willing and interested in supporting us because we have a bankable strategy. We are not going to ask for more money.”
There’s a lot of mystery surrounding the carrier’s finances

As flagged by View from the Wing , one certainly can’t help but be skeptical of all of the carrier’s financial claims. SAA’s annual financial report ending March 31, 2025, suggests that the airline group had a net profit of 155 million ZAR, or 9.3 million USD, while the airline as such had a net profit of 30 million ZAR, or 1.8 million USD.

Okay, that’s not exactly a huge profit, but at least it’s not a loss, right? Well, there’s more to the story. Before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortization, the airline group had a loss of 317 million ZAR, or 19 million USD. And the airline also had gains of 1.169 billion ZAR, or 70.1 million USD, under the asset disposal line. This could partly be attributed to selling slots at Heathrow and a lease-modification gain.

The point is, it sounds like SAA wasn’t in a great financial situation before the current crisis, and also didn’t have much of a safety net. So the current situation is only making matters worse. While the company is downplaying how dire the situation is, typically you don’t have to pay pilots late if you’re in even a remotely decent situation. It’ll be interesting to see what’s next for the airline…

South African Airways is struggling to pay staff on-time, with up to 40% of employees having their pay deferred. The airline is blaming higher fuel prices, which are of course impacting the entire industry. South Africa’s national carrier has received billions in bailouts over the years, and claims everything is fine, but even the past numbers don’t exactly paint a great picture of the situation. South African’s “profit” over the last fully reported financial year was due to special items and the sale of slots, rather than an actual operating profit.
It sure seems like the airline may need a bailout sooner rather than later, or else it might be looking at some real issues, since you can’t just delay payment for staff on an ongoing basis.
What do you make of this South African Airways situation?
body_zh: 南非航空公司 (SAA) 在过去 15 年左右的时间里一直面临着相当严重的财务问题。 2021 年，该航空公司摆脱了“商业救援”，资产负债表干净（并且是以前的外壳），从那时起它就一直在稳步前进。
然而，该航空公司似乎再次陷入困境，因为很大一部分员工没有拿到工资。尽管公司高管坚称一切都很好，但谁也说不准事情会如何发展。
南非航空淡化财务问题
据报道，南非航空公司目前无法支付 30-40% 员工的工资，声称必须优先考虑关键的运营成本。该航空公司推迟了管理层、飞行员、高管和董事会成员的工资，并将原因归咎于燃油价格上涨。
该公司企业事务主管姆皮洛·德拉米尼 (Mpilo Dlamini) 解释说，南非航空自摆脱商业救助以来一直面临注资不足的问题，但坚称该航空公司不会寻求救助
“在企业救援过程之后，我们没有获得足够的资本注入来维持我们的生存，缓冲我们的成本，确保我们按照我们想要的方式扩张。因此，我想承认，有些问题使我们在流动性方面受到了影响。”
“董事会和管理层致力于确保我们实际上是通过担保从政府那里获得的支持。我们正在与我们的一些金融机构进行谈判和接触，我现在必须向你们确认，他们愿意并且有兴趣支持我们，因为我们有一个可融资的战略。我们不会要求更多的钱。”
该航空公司的财务状况存在很多谜团
正如《View from the Wing》所指出的那样，人们肯定会忍不住对这家航空公司的所有财务声明表示怀疑。 SAA截至2025年3月31日的年度财务报告显示，该航空集团的净利润为1.55亿南非兰特，即930万美元，而航空公司本身的净利润为3000万南非兰特，即180万美元。
好吧，这不完全是巨额利润，但至少不是亏损，对吧？嗯，这个故事还有更多内容。未计利息、税项、折旧及摊销前，该航空集团亏损 3.17 亿南非兰特，即 1900 万美元。该航空公司在资产处置额度下还获得了 11.69 亿南非兰特（约合 7010 万美元）的收益。这可能部分归因于希思罗机场航班时刻的出售和租赁修改收益。
关键是，听起来南非航空在当前危机之前的财务状况并不好，而且也没有太多的安全网。因此，目前的情况只会让事情变得更糟。虽然该公司淡化了情况的严重程度，但通常情况下，如果你的情况还算不错，你也不必迟付飞行员工资。看看该航空公司的下一步发展将会很有趣……
南非航空公司很难按时向员工支付工资，多达 40% 的员工被推迟支付工资。该航空公司将此归咎于燃油价格上涨，这当然影响了整个行业。南非国家航空公司多年来已获得数十亿美元的救助，并声称一切都很好，但即使是过去的数字也不能完全描绘出情况的美好图景。南非在上一个完整报告的财政年度的“利润”是由于特殊项目和老虎机的销售，而不是实际的营业利润。
看来航空公司可能需要尽快获得救助，否则它可能会考虑一些真正的问题，因为你不能只是持续推迟向员工支付工资。

title_en: Philippine Airlines Business Class Airbus A350 Review: Great Seats, But Missing Heart
title_zh: 菲律宾航空商务舱空客 A350 评测：座位很棒，但缺心
summary: Philippine Airlines' new A350-1000 business class has excellent reverse herringbone seats and decent food, but broken Wi-Fi and a disinterested crew left the experience short of its potential.
summary_zh: 菲律宾航空的新型 A350-1000 商务舱拥有出色的反人字形座椅和不错的食物，但 Wi-Fi 坏了，机组人员也不感兴趣。
body_en: For the long haul segment of the return portion of my first class quest to Japan , I flew Philippine Airlines’ Airbus A350-1000 business class on the 11hr55min flight from Manila (MNL) to San Francisco (SFO). I was very much looking forward to this flight, given that this is the carrier’s new flagship aircraft , featuring all-new cabins.

Ultimately my Philippine Airlines business class flight was good, especially when you account for value, given that Philippine Airlines tends to undercut the competition on price. If you can get over the awful ground experience in Manila , then there’s definitely value to be had here.

On the plus side, the cabin was brand new, and the food was pretty good. However, there were also some shortcomings, like the inoperable Wi-Fi, and there was maybe an x-factor missing with the soft product. Furthermore, while the crew was friendly enough, they didn’t have the warmth or attentiveness of the crew on my previous flight, as it felt like they were just going through the motions and disinterested.

So my conclusion is that this flight was a great deal, and I’d absolutely recommend this product if the price is right. But I feel like if Philippine Airlines tried a little harder, it could truly have a top tier product.
How I booked my Philippine Airlines business class ticket

I booked my return itinerary from Osaka to Manila to San Francisco as one ticket, with the first flight on the Airbus A330 ( which I’ve already reviewed — that seat sucks! ), and the second flight on the Airbus A350. I booked the following ticket, which cost $1,746.63
9/19 PR411 Osaka to Manila departing 3:15PM arriving 6:40PM
9/19 PR104 Manila to San Francisco departing 11:15PM arriving 9:10PM

However, I ended up offsetting the cost of this ticket with points, so I really booked it with 116,442 Chase Ultimate Rewards points, because I could redeem for 1.5 cents each toward the cost of the ticket. That’s a reasonable paid fare, and in this case, I preferred redeeming points rather than having to spend the cash out of pocket.
Philippine Airlines business class lounge & boarding

In a previous installment, I reviewed the Philippine Airlines Mabuhay Lounge Manila , which is just awful, in my opinion. It was so bad that I went and sat out in the terminal, which is saying something, because the airport’s Terminal 1 makes JFK Terminal 1 (not the new one!) look like Singapore Changi, by comparison!

My flight was departing from gate five, with boarding scheduled for 10:30PM, 45 minutes before departure. All the US-bound flights from Manila depart from one area, with a centralized security check. It was quick for me, though obviously if you get “SSSS” on your boarding pass , you’ll get a more thorough inspection.

The gate area in this part of the terminal is just so poorly set up, as it’s a sea of seats, without many ways to easily pass through there. And as you’d expect, there are typically multiple flights departing at peak times, so it gets quite busy. There is a dedicated seating area for business class passengers, but there’s nothing actually special about that.
Boarding ended up starting at 10:30PM, with dozens and dozens of wheelchairs passengers boarding first. Business class passengers were then invited to board around 15 minutes later.
Philippine Airlines A350 business class cabin & seats

I boarded through the forward left door, where I was greeted by the crew, and then turned right into the cabin. I’m usually really good at boarding first and getting pictures, but unfortunately by the time I boarded, around half of the business class passengers were seated (as wheelchair passengers get pre-boarding).

Philippine Airlines’ A350-1000s are equipped with the Collins Aerospace Elevation product, which is essentially the rebranding and slight evolution of the Super Diamond product, the world’s most popular reverse herringbone seat. Seats have 44″ of pitch, 21″ of width, and turn into 78″ flat beds.
The business class cabin consists of a total of 42 seats, spread across 11 rows, in a 1-2-1 configuration. This takes up the entire space between the first and second set of doors.

If you’re traveling with someone, you may want to select the pair of center seats, so that you can sit next to your companion. However, reverse herringbone seats aren’t ideal for this, since you do have to lean forward quite a bit to communicate with the person across from you. If you’re traveling alone and end up in a center seat, there’s also a privacy shield that you can extend between seats.

If possible, solo travelers will of course want to select one of the window seats, since these offer the most privacy, and give you aisle access and a view. I assigned myself seat 10A, the window seat on the left side in the last row of the cabin.
body_zh: 在我前往日本的头等舱返程部分的长途航段中，我乘坐菲律宾航空公司的空客 A350-1000 商务舱，从马尼拉 (MNL) 飞往旧金山 (SFO)，飞行时间为 11 小时 55 分钟。我非常期待这次飞行，因为这是该航空公司的新旗舰飞机，拥有全新的客舱。
最终，我的菲律宾航空商务舱航班很好，特别是当你考虑到价值时，因为菲律宾航空往往会削弱价格竞争。如果您能克服在马尼拉糟糕的地面体验，那么这里绝对值得一去。
从好的方面来说，小屋是全新的，食物也很不错。不过，也有一些缺点，比如 Wi-Fi 无法使用，而且软产品可能存在未知因素。此外，虽然机组人员足够友好，但他们没有我之前航班上机组人员的热情或专注，因为感觉他们只是走走过场，不感兴趣。
所以我的结论是，这次航班很划算，如果价格合适，我绝对会推荐这个产品。但我觉得如果菲律宾航空再努力一点，它就能真正拥有顶级产品。
我如何预订菲律宾航空商务舱机票
我以一张机票的形式预订了从大阪到马尼拉再到旧金山的往返行程，第一趟航班是空客 A330（我已经评论过——那个座位太糟糕了！），第二趟航班是空客 A350。我预订了以下机票，价格为 1,746.63 美元
9/19 PR411 大阪 至 马尼拉 出发 下午 3:15 到达 下午 6:40
9/19 PR104 马尼拉 至 旧金山 出发时间 11:15PM 到达 9:10PM
然而，我最终用积分抵消了这张机票的费用，所以我真的用 116,442 Chase Ultimate Rewards 积分预订了它，因为我可以将每张机票兑换 1.5 美分。这是一个合理的付费票价，在这种情况下，我更喜欢兑换积分，而不是自掏腰包花掉现金。
菲律宾航空商务舱休息室和登机
在上一篇文章中，我回顾了菲律宾航空马尼拉马布海休息室，在我看来，这太糟糕了。情况太糟糕了，我坐在航站楼外面，这很说明问题，因为相比之下，肯尼迪机场 1 号航站楼让肯尼迪国际机场 1 号航站楼（不是新航站楼！）看起来像新加坡樟宜！
我的航班从 5 号登机口起飞，登机时间定于晚上 10:30，即起飞前 45 分钟。所有从马尼拉飞往美国的航班均从一个区域出发，并进行集中安全检查。对我来说很快，但显然如果你的登机牌上有“SSSS”，你会得到更彻底的检查。
航站楼这部分的登机口区域设置得非常糟糕，因为那里有很多座位，没有很多方法可以轻松通过那里。正如您所料，高峰时段通常有多个航班起飞，因此会变得非常繁忙。商务舱乘客有一个专门的座位区，但实际上并没有什么特别的。
晚上10点30分开始登机，数十名轮椅乘客先登机。大约 15 分钟后，商务舱乘客被邀请登机。
菲律宾航空 A350 商务舱客舱和座椅
我从左前门登机，机组人员在那里迎接我，然后右转进入机舱。我通常很擅长先登机并拍照，但不幸的是，当我登机时，大约一半的商务舱乘客已经就座（因为轮椅乘客需要提前登机）。
菲律宾航空的 A350-1000 飞机配备了柯林斯航空高程产品，该产品本质上是全球最受欢迎的反人字形座椅 Super Diamond 产品的品牌重塑和轻微演变。座椅间距为 44 英寸，宽度为 21 英寸，可变成 78 英寸的平床。
公务舱共有 42 个座位，分布在 11 排，呈 1-2-1 布局。这占据了第一组门和第二组门之间的整个空间。
如果您与某人一起旅行，您可能需要选择一对中间的座位，这样您就可以坐在同伴旁边。然而，反人字形座椅对此并不理想，因为你必须向前倾斜很多才能与对面的人交流。如果您独自旅行并最终坐在中间座位，您还可以在座位之间延伸一个隐私护罩。
如果可能的话，独行旅客当然会选择靠窗的座位，因为这些座位提供了最大的私密性，并且可以让您进入过道并欣赏风景。我给自己安排了10A座位，即客舱最后一排左侧靠窗的座位。

title_en: Sri Lankan lawmaker faces 24 charges in Airbus bribery case
title_zh: 斯里兰卡议员因空客贿赂案面临24项指控
summary: Sri Lankan lawmaker Namal Rajapaksa faces 24 charges over an alleged 100 million rupee ($1 million) bribe linked… The post Sri Lankan lawmaker faces 24 charges in Airbus bribery case appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 斯里兰卡议员纳迈勒·拉贾帕克萨因涉嫌行贿 1 亿卢比（100 万美元）而面临 24 项指控……这位斯里兰卡议员面临 2 项指控
body_en: Sri Lankan lawmaker Namal Rajapaksa faces 24 charges over an alleged 100 million rupee ($1 million) bribe linked to SriLankan Airlines’ purchase of Airbus aircraft.
Prosecutors recently informed a court in Colombo, Sri Lanka, that formal charges had been filed against Rajapaksa in the High Court.

Rajapaksa, the son of former President Mahinda Rajapaksa, has denied wrongdoing. He was arrested on September 4, 2026, after questioning by Sri Lanka’s Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption.

He appeared before the three-judge High Court bench on October 28, 2026. The court ordered that he be brought back on November 19, with Rajapaksa remaining in custody, according to local news outlets.
The indictment also names Shamindra Rajapaksa, Priyanka Niyomalie and Biz Solutions (Pvt) Ltd.
The allegations concern payments connected to the national carrier’s 2013 aircraft order for six Airbus A330-300s and four A350-900s. The A350s were never delivered.
Investigators allege that money connected to the transaction passed through overseas companies and bank accounts before reaching Rajapaksa.

An $800,000 transfer allegedly went from a Singapore account held by Biz Solutions to Sabre Vision Holdings, a company owned by a Sri Lankan businessman. Investigators charge that the businessman subsequently paid 100 million rupees in bribes in 2014 and 2015.
The aircraft purchase has been the subject of investigations and compensation demands for years.

In 2021, SriLankan Airlines sought $1 billion from Airbus for damages, reputational harm and other costs. It also demanded cancellation of its agreement for four A350-900s and the return of $19 million in advance payments.

The airline’s action followed disclosures in the wider Airbus corruption investigation. In January 2020, Airbus agreed to pay more than $3.9 billion to resolve bribery and export-control cases with authorities in the US, France and the United Kingdom. The British case covered payments involving Sri Lanka and four other countries.
Former SriLankan Airlines CEO Kapila Chandrasena, who also faced charges connected to the aircraft purchase, was found dead in Colombo in May 2026 .

body_zh: 斯里兰卡议员纳迈勒·拉贾帕克萨因涉嫌与斯里兰卡航空公司购买空客飞机有关的 1 亿卢比（100 万美元）贿赂而面临 24 项指控。
检察官最近通知斯里兰卡科伦坡法院，已向高等法院对拉贾帕克萨提出正式指控。
前总统马欣达·拉贾帕克萨的儿子拉贾帕克萨否认有不当行为。在接受斯里兰卡贿赂或腐败指控调查委员会讯问后，他于 2026 年 9 月 4 日被捕。
他于 2026 年 10 月 28 日出现在由三名法官组成的高等法院法官席上。据当地新闻媒体报道，法院下令于 11 月 19 日将他带回，拉贾帕克萨仍被拘留。
起诉书还点名了 Shamindra Rajapaksa、Priyanka Niyomalie 和 Biz Solutions (Pvt) Ltd.。
这些指控涉及与该国家航空公司 2013 年购买的六架空客 A330-300 和四架 A350-900 飞机订单相关的付款。 A350 从未交付。
调查人员称，与交易相关的资金在到达拉贾帕克萨之前通过海外公司和银行账户。
据称，一笔 80 万美元的资金从 Biz Solutions 持有的新加坡账户转至一名斯里兰卡商人拥有的 Sabre Vision Holdings 公司。调查人员指控，该商人随后在 2014 年和 2015 年行贿 1 亿卢比。
多年来，这架飞机的购买一直是调查和赔偿要求的主题。
2021年，斯里兰卡航空向空中客车公司索赔10亿美元，用于赔偿损失、声誉损害和其他费用。它还要求取消四架 A350-900 的协议，并退还 1900 万美元的预付款。
该航空公司的行动是在更广泛的空客腐败调查披露之后采取的。 2020 年 1 月，空客同意支付超过 39 亿美元，以解决与美国、法国和英国当局的贿赂和出口管制案件。英国案件涉及涉及斯里兰卡和其他四个国家的付款。
斯里兰卡航空公司前首席执行官卡皮拉·钱德拉塞纳 (Kapila Chandrasena) 于 2026 年 5 月被发现死于科伦坡，他也面临与购买飞机有关的指控。
这名前斯里兰卡议员在空客贿赂案中面临 24 项指控，最早出现在 AeroTime 上。

KLM’s first Airbus A350-900 has operated its inaugural passenger flight from Amsterdam Schiphol to Toronto. Named De Nachtwacht (“The Night Watch”), the aircraft departed as flight KL691 with passengers and eight tonnes of cargo aboard.

The inaugural attracted aviation enthusiasts who booked specifically for the occasion, including two passengers wearing specially printed T-shirts and a father and son who travelled from New York to join the flight.

The A350’s introduction forms part of KLM’s fleet-renewal programme, which the airline says aims to reduce fuel consumption, emissions and noise. Following Toronto, planned destinations for the aircraft include Montreal, Kilimanjaro, Dar es Salaam, Nairobi and Zanzibar.

body_en: Air Transat adds Geneva and Birmingham among five new European routes for summer 2027 - Aviation24.be
Air Transat has announced five new non-stop routes between Canada and Europe for summer 2027, including services to two new destinations: Geneva from Montreal and Birmingham from Toronto.
The Canadian leisure airline will also launch Quebec City–Lyon, Quebec City–Barcelona and Montreal–Faro services. The announced schedule is

Route Weekly flights Operating days Operating period in 2027 Montreal–Geneva 2 Tuesday, Saturday 19 June–23 October Toronto–Birmingham 2 Tuesday, Friday 22 June–22 October Quebec City–Lyon 1 Tuesday 8 June–26 October Quebec City–Barcelona 1 Monday 14 June–25 October Montreal–Faro 1 Monday 14 June–25 October

Birmingham will complement Air Transat’s existing London and Manchester services from Toronto. Faro, already served from Toronto, will become its third Portuguese destination from Montreal, alongside Lisbon and Porto.
The additions of Lyon and Barcelona will bring Air Transat’s non-stop European network from Quebec City to five destinations, joining Paris, Marseille and Nantes.
Meanwhile, Quebec City–Puerto Plata and Montreal–St Maarten will be extended to year-round operation, with one weekly summer flight on Mondays and Saturdays, respectively.

这家加拿大休闲航空公司还将推出魁北克市-里昂、魁北克市-巴塞罗那和蒙特利尔-法鲁航班。公布的时间表是

Three people died when two helicopters collided in mid-air near McMinnville Municipal Airport (MMV) in Oregon at around 14:15 local time on 29 October 2026, according to local authorities.

The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) identified the aircraft as a Robinson R22 (reg. N501HL) conducting an instructional flight and an Airbus H125/AS350B3 (reg. N704RH) on a maintenance flight. Both crashed into a private farm field near the airport, approximately 64 kilometres southwest of Portland.

Yamhill County Sheriff Sam Elliott identified two victims as flight instructor Maddie Aasbo, 22, and pilot Tyler Sturdevant, 38. A British student pilot, whose name was not released, also died. Aasbo and the student were aboard one helicopter, while Sturdevant was alone in the other.

Jerry Trimble Helicopters confirmed that one of its aircraft was involved and said it was cooperating with investigators. The NTSB is leading the investigation, with the Federal Aviation Administration also participating. The circumstances of the collision remain under investigation.

杰里·特林布尔直升机公司证实其一架飞机参与其中，并表示正在配合调查人员的调查。美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）正在牵头调查，联邦航空管理局也参与其中。碰撞情况仍在调查中。

title_en: Discover Airlines Adding 13 Airbus A350s, Starting With Four Ex-Lufthansa Jets
title_zh: 了解航空公司增加 13 架空客 A350，首先是四架前汉莎航空喷气式飞机
summary: Discover Airlines will take over four former Lufthansa A350-900s in 2027 and 2028, followed by nine new ones from 2029, with first routes including Calgary and Orlando.
summary_zh: 探索航空将在 2027 年和 2028 年接管四架前汉莎航空 A350-900 飞机，随后从 2029 年开始接收九架新飞机，首批航线包括
body_en: Discover Airlines is Lufthansa Group’s long haul leisure carrier based in Germany. The airline has been growing in recent years, as Lufthansa Group (unsurprisingly) sees a lot of potential with its low cost operations. As a matter of fact, Lufthansa Group seems committed to growing everything except its flagship brand, Lufthansa.

In 2024, we first learned that the Discover Airlines fleet will grow in the coming years , and that we’ll eventually see the introduction of a new business class product. Then in 2025, we learned that the airline would start to acquire Airbus A350s. We now have a lot more details about what that will look like , including the timeline, as well as the first routes to be operated by the plane.
Discover Airlines modernizing long haul fleet with A350s
Discover Airlines has plans to acquire a total of 13 Airbus A350-900s. This will be a two-step process
In 2027 and 2028, the airline will take over four former Lufthansa A350-900s, as those will gradually be put into service
In 2029 and beyond, the airline will take delivery of nine factory fresh A350-900s, all of which were part of a larger Lufthansa Group order
For context, Discover Airlines’ long haul fleet currently consists of 13 Airbus A330s — that’s now limited to the A330-300 variant, as the A330-200 variant has just been retired.

The current expectation is that the first former Lufthansa A350 will join the fleet in June 2027. It will initially operate short haul routes for crew familiarization, before flying long haul from Frankfurt (FRA) to Calgary (YYC) and Orlando (MCO).

The second A350 will then join the fleet in December 2027, with service on the plane being added to San Jose (SJO) and Belize City (BZE). The third and fourth A350 will then join the fleet in the summer of 2028.

By mid-2028, Discover Airlines expects its long haul fleet to grow to 20 aircraft, which includes the four former Lufthansa A350s, as well as some additional former Lufthansa A330s that will be added to the fleet.

It’s worth remembering that Lufthansa is the least profitable airline of Lufthansa Group. Rather than addressing that directly, Lufthansa Group’s solution to this issue is to continue outsourcing flying. For example, Lufthansa is about to drop flights to Seattle (SEA), as those will instead be operated by Discover Airlines. So it really shows you what a core part of Lufthansa’s plan this subsidiary is.

Discover Airlines isn’t the only Lufthansa Group leisure subsidiary getting A350s. SWISS’ leisure subsidiary, Edelweiss Air, is fully refreshing its long haul fleet, replacing A340-300s with A350-900s . In Edelweiss’ case, those are former LATAM jets that were retired early. These planes will also soon get new interiors, and the first aircraft should be retrofitted with all-new cabins in the coming months.
What to expect onboard Discover Airlines A350s

In typical Lufthansa Group fashion, Discover Airlines has acquired most of its aircraft simply by being given Lufthansa planes as they’ve been retired. So most of Discover Airlines’ A330s have the typical “old” Lufthansa business class , in a 2-2-2 configuration.

So you might be thinking that these initial four A350s that Discover Airlines is getting also have those interiors, given that most Lufthansa A350s also have business class seats in a 2-2-2 configuration .

However, not surprisingly, there’s another angle here. In 2021, Lufthansa opportunistically picked up four ex-Philippine Airlines A350s , as the carrier was going through a reorganization. Lufthansa maintained the cabin interiors , which funny enough, actually elevated Lufthansa’s business class experience considerably, given that these planes have Thompson Aero Vantage XL seats.

There was always the question of what Lufthansa would eventually do with these planes, so it’s not surprising that they’re now going to a different subsidiary. Meanwhile Lufthansa’s A350s with the old business class are all eventually going to be reconfigured with Allegris cabins . So when these four special A350s are taken over by Discover Airlines, you can expect that interiors will be maintained.

Now, what about those nine factory fresh A350s that will join the fleet starting in 2029? We don’t yet know what we can expect from those interiors. From a standardization standpoint, I suppose it’s possible that the airline gets the same business class you’ll find with Lufthansa’s A350 Allegris business class and SWISS Senses’ A350 business class .

However, what’s interesting here is that Discover Airlines is also rolling out a new business class product on its existing A330s. This is an off the shelf product, which is probably smart from the company’s perspective, given all the certification issues we’ve seen over time. So I suppose it’s possible that this will also be introduced on the A350s… we’ll see!

Discover Airlines will be modernizing its long haul fleet, as the airline will eventually take delivery of 13 Airbus A350-900s. In 2027 and 2028, we’ll see the airline acquire four Lufthansa A350s, and specifically, the planes that are former Philippine Airlines aircraft. Then in 2029 and beyond, we’ll see the airline get nine factory fresh A350s, part of the larger Lufthansa Group order.
body_zh: 探索航空是汉莎航空集团旗下的长途休闲航空公司，总部位于德国。近年来，该航空公司一直在发展，汉莎集团（毫不奇怪）看到了其低成本运营的巨大潜力。事实上，汉莎集团似乎致力于发展除其旗舰品牌汉莎航空之外的一切。
2024 年，我们首次获悉发现航空机队将在未来几年增长，并且我们最终将看到推出新的商务舱产品。然后在 2025 年，我们得知该航空公司将开始采购空客 A350。我们现在有更多关于它的细节，包括时间表，以及飞机将运营的第一条航线。
探索航空公司利用 A350 实现长途机队现代化
发现航空公司计划购买总共 13 架空客 A350-900 飞机。这将分为两个步骤
2027年和2028年，该航空公司将接收四架前汉莎航空A350-900飞机，这些飞机将逐步投入使用
2029 年及以后，该航空公司将接收九架工厂全新 A350-900 飞机，所有这些都是汉莎航空集团更大订单的一部分
就背景而言，Discover Airlines 的长途机队目前由 13 架空客 A330 组成，现在仅限于 A330-300 型号，因为 A330-200 型号刚刚退役。
目前预计第一架前汉莎航空 A350 将于 2027 年 6 月加入机队。它最初将运营短途航线，以供机组人员熟悉，然后再执飞从法兰克福 (FRA) 飞往卡尔加里 (YYC) 和奥兰多 (MCO) 的长途航线。
第二架 A350 将于 2027 年 12 月加入机队，该飞机的服务范围将增加到圣何塞 (SJO) 和伯利兹城 (BZE)。第三架和第四架 A350 将于 2028 年夏季加入机队。
到 2028 年中期，发现航空预计其长途机队将增至 20 架飞机，其中包括四架前汉莎航空 A350 飞机，以及将添加到机队中的一些前汉莎航空 A330 飞机。
值得记住的是，汉莎航空是汉莎集团利润最低的航空公司。汉莎航空集团对此问题的解决方案不是直接解决这个问题，而是继续外包飞行。例如，汉莎航空即将取消飞往西雅图 (SEA) 的航班，而这些航班将由探索航空 (Discover Airlines) 运营。所以它确实向您展示了汉莎航空这家子公司计划的核心部分。
发现航空并不是唯一一家拥有 A350 飞机的汉莎航空集团休闲子公司。瑞航的休闲子公司 Edelweiss Air 正在全面更新其长途机队，用 A350-900 取代 A340-300。在 Edelweiss 的案例中，这些是提前退役的前 LATAM 喷气式飞机。这些飞机也将很快获得新的内饰，第一架飞机应该在未来几个月内改装全新的客舱。
发现航空 A350 飞机上有哪些值得期待的事情
按照汉莎航空集团的典型方式，发现航空通过向汉莎航空退役飞机购买了大部分飞机。因此，大多数发现航空公司的 A330 飞机都具有典型的“旧”汉莎航空商务舱，采用 2-2-2 配置。
因此，您可能会认为，发现航空最初购买的四架 A350 也具有这些内饰，因为大多数汉莎航空 A350 也有 2-2-2 配置的商务舱座椅。
然而，毫不奇怪，这里还有另一个角度。 2021 年，汉莎航空趁机收购了四架前菲律宾航空 A350，当时该航空公司正在进行重组。汉莎航空保留了机舱内饰，这很有趣，实际上大大提高了汉莎航空的商务舱体验，因为这些飞机配备了 Thompson Aero Vantage XL 座椅。
一直以来，人们都在问汉莎航空最终将如何处理这些飞机，因此它们现在转到另一家子公司也就不足为奇了。与此同时，汉莎航空的 A350 旧商务舱最终都将重新配置 Allegris 客舱。因此，当这四架特殊的 A350 被发现航空公司接管时，您可以预期内饰将得到保留。
那么，从 2029 年开始加入机队的 9 架新出厂 A350 又如何呢？我们还不知道这些内饰能带来什么。从标准化的角度来看，我认为该航空公司可能会提供与汉莎航空的 A350 Allegris 商务舱和 SWISS Senses 的 A350 商务舱相同的商务舱。
然而，有趣的是，Discover Airlines 还在其现有的 A330 飞机上推出了新的商务舱产品。这是一款现成的产品，考虑到我们长期以来看到的所有认证问题，从公司的角度来看，这可能是明智的。所以我想这也可能会被引入到 A350s 上……我们拭目以待！
Discover Airlines 将对其长途机队进行现代化改造，该航空公司最终将接收 13 架空客 A350-900。 2027 年和 2028 年，我们将看到该航空公司收购四架汉莎航空 A350，特别是前菲律宾航空公司的飞机。然后，在 2029 年及以后，我们将看到该航空公司获得 9 架工厂全新 A350，这是汉莎航空集团更大订单的一部分。

body_en: LOT retires final Embraer E170 after more than 22 years - Aviation24.be
Home Embraer E Jets LOT retires final Embraer E170 after more than 22 years

LOT Polish Airlines is bidding farewell to its Embraer E170 fleet on 30 October 2026, with its final aircraft, SP-LDH, scheduled to operate a last Warsaw–Vienna–Warsaw passenger rotation. The route mirrors the type’s commercial debut with LOT on 17 March 2004, when the Polish carrier became the world’s first E170 operator.

According to LOT, the 10 E170s it operated carried 13.8 million passengers on nearly 300,000 flights, accumulating more than 455,000 flight hours and covering over 230 million kilometres. Configured with 70 to 76 seats in a two-by-two layout, the aircraft served domestic and European routes, including Prague, Copenhagen and Budapest.
The first aircraft, SP-LDA, arrived in Warsaw on 8 March 2004 and remained with LOT until 2014. The E170 introduced winglets and fully electronic fly-by-wire flight controls to the airline’s fleet.
The retirement ends LOT’s operation of the smallest E-Jet variant, but its Embraer fleet continues to include E175s, E190s, E195s and E195-E2s.
Source: LOT Polish Airlines press release, 30 October 2026.

主页 Embraer E Jets LOT 退役超过 22 年后最后一架 Embraer E170
LOT 波兰航空将于 2026 年 10 月 30 日告别其巴西航空工业公司 E170 机队，其最后一架飞机 SP-LDH 计划运营最后一次华沙 - 维也纳 - 华沙​​客运航线。该航线反映了该机型于 2004 年 3 月 17 日在 LOT 上的商业首次亮相，当时这家波兰航空公司成为世界上第一家 E170 运营商。
据LOT介绍，其运营的10架E170飞机已运送乘客1380万人次，执行近30万个航班，累计飞行超过45.5万小时，飞行里程超过2.3亿公里。该飞机配置有 70 至 76 个座位，采用 2×2 布局，提供国内和欧洲航线，包括布拉格、哥本哈根和布达佩斯。
第一架飞机 SP-LDA 于 2004 年 3 月 8 日抵达华沙，并一直在 LOT 服役直至 2014 年。E170 为该航空公司的机队引入了小翼和全电子电传飞行控制系统。
此次退役结束了 LOT 最小 E-Jet 机型的运营，但其巴西航空工业公司机队仍包括 E175、E190、E195 和 E195-E2。
资料来源：LOT 波兰航空新闻稿，2026 年 10 月 30 日。
