title_zh: 史上最佳花旗AAdvantage行政卡12.5万奖励里程优惠即将结束
summary: The Citi AAdvantage Executive Card is offering a limited-time bonus of 125,000 AAdvantage miles after spending $15,000 in five months.
summary_zh: Citi AAdvantage Executive Card在五个月内消费$ 15,000后，将提供125,000 AAdvantage里程的限时奖励。
body_en: We’re currently seeing a huge limited time welcome bonus on the Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard® . If you’ve been interested in applying with this bonus, this is a final reminder that this offer ends soon, so now is the time to apply.

This limited time welcome bonus comes just shortly after the AAdvantage Executive Card has undergone a refresh — while the card’s fee has gone up (from $595 to $695 per year), the value has potentially increased as well. Regardless of the welcome offer, this is a genuinely rewarding card, which offers lounge access, bonus Loyalty Points, and much more.
The Citi Executive Card is a product that I’ve personally had for years. In this post, I’d like to recap the details of this bonus, as this is the ideal time to apply.
Link: Learn more about the Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard®
Citi AAdvantage Executive Card 125K miles welcome offer

The Citi AAdvantage Executive Card is offering a limited time welcome bonus of 125,000 AAdvantage bonus miles after making $15,000 in purchases within the first five months of account opening, and this offer ends soon. This is the highest-ever offer that we’ve seen on the card.

Based on my latest miles & points valuations , AAdvantage miles are worth 1.5 cents each, so to me that bonus is worth $1,875. There are some incredible uses of American AAdvantage miles , so you can redeem this for experiences like Etihad’s A350 business class or Qatar Airways’ A350 business class .

Also keep in mind that any spending on the card will qualify for Loyalty Points (helping you earn elite status, including Gold , Platinum , Platinum Pro , or Executive Platinum ), though the welcome bonus as such won’t.
Citi AAdvantage Executive Card eligibility requirements

If you’re interested in applying for the Citi AAdvantage Executive Card , the typical Citi credit card application restrictions apply, including that you can be approved for at most one Citi card every eight days, and at most two Citi cards every 65 days.

On top of that, the bonus isn’t available to those who have received a new account bonus on this exact card in the past 48 months. Eligibility is unrelated to having any other American Airlines credit card, so you’re eligible for this card even if you have other products, like the Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard® ( learn more ).
Read my guide to Citi AAdvantage Executive Card approval .
Why the Citi AAdvantage Executive Card is worth it

The Citi AAdvantage Executive Card has a $695 annual fee (you can receive a $145 discount if you’re a Citigold client ), though it offers a bunch of perks that can help offset that. For one, the AAdvantage Executive Card is the best card for accessing American Admirals Clubs
The Citi AAdvantage Executive Card offers an Admirals Club membership for the primary cardmember

The Citi AAdvantage Executive Card offers Admirals Club access for authorized users; you can add up to three authorized users for a total of $175 (so potentially under $60 each), and then beyond that it’s $175 per authorized user

What’s the difference between the Admirals Club membership for the primary cardmember and Admirals Club access for authorized users? Well, the member can access some partner lounges, like Alaska Lounges , while the authorized users can’t.

Regardless, the primary cardmember and authorized users are each able to bring two guests or their immediate family into Admirals Clubs when flying American or an eligible partner airline on the same day.
On top of that, the AAdvantage Executive Card offers a variety of other perks, including
A first checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for the primary cardmember and up to eight companions on the same reservation
body_zh: 目前，我们在 Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard® 上看到了巨额限时欢迎奖金。如果您有兴趣申请此奖金，这是最后一次提醒，此优惠即将结束，所以现在是申请的时候了。
这项限时欢迎奖金是在 AAdvantage Executive 卡更新后不久推出的——虽然该卡的费用上涨了（从每年 595 美元到 695 美元），但其价值也可能增加。无论欢迎优惠如何，这都是一张真正的奖励卡，提供休息室使用权、奖励忠诚积分等等。
花旗行政卡是我个人拥有多年的产品。在这篇文章中，我想回顾一下这项奖金的详细信息，因为这是申请的理想时机。
链接：了解有关 Citi® / AAdvantage® Executive World Legend Mastercard® 的更多信息
Citi AAdvantage Executive 卡 125K 英里迎新优惠
Citi AAdvantage Executive 卡在开户后的前五个月内消费满 15,000 美元后，将提供 125,000 AAdvantage 奖励里程的限时欢迎奖金，此优惠即将结束。这是我们在该卡上看到的最高优惠。
根据我最新的里程和积分估值，每 AAdvantage 里程价值 1.5 美分，所以对我来说奖金价值 1,875 美元。美国 AAdvantage 里程有一些令人难以置信的用途，因此您可以将其兑换为阿提哈德航空的 A350 商务舱或卡塔尔航空的 A350 商务舱等体验。
另请记住，该卡上的任何消费都将有资格获得忠诚积分（帮助您获得精英身份，包括金卡、白金卡、专业白金卡或行政白金卡），但欢迎奖金本身则不会。
花旗 AAdvantage Executive 卡资格要求
如果您有兴趣申请花旗 AAdvantage Executive 卡，则适用典型的花旗信用卡申请限制，包括每 8 天最多可以批准一张花旗卡，每 65 天最多可以批准两张花旗卡。
最重要的是，在过去 48 个月内通过这张卡收到新账户奖金的人无法获得该奖金。资格与拥有任何其他美国航空信用卡无关，因此即使您拥有其他产品，例如 Citi® / AAdvantage® Globe™ Mastercard®（了解更多），您也有资格获得此卡。
请阅读我的 Citi AAdvantage Executive 卡审批指南。
为什么 Citi AAdvantage Executive 卡值得购买
花旗 AAdvantage Executive 卡的年费为 695 美元（如果您是 Citigold 客户，则可以享受 145 美元的折扣），不过它提供了一系列福利来帮助抵消年费。其一，AAdvantage Executive 卡是进入美国海军上将俱乐部的最佳卡
Citi AAdvantage Executive 卡为主卡会员提供 Admirals Club 会员资格
花旗 AAdvantage Executive 卡为授权用户提供 Admirals Club 访问权限；您最多可以添加三个授权用户，总费用为 175 美元（因此每个授权用户的费用可能低于 60 美元），除此之外，每个授权用户的费用为 175 美元
主卡会员的 Admirals Club 会员资格和授权用户的 Admirals Club 访问权限有何区别？那么，会员可以访问一些合作伙伴休息室，例如阿拉斯加休息室，而授权用户则不能。
无论如何，主卡会员和授权用户在同一天乘坐美国航空公司或符合条件的合作伙伴航空公司的航班时，都可以携带两名客人或其直系亲属进入 Admirals Club。
除此之外，AAdvantage Executive 卡还提供各种其他福利，包括
主卡会员和同一预订中最多八名同伴可在美国航空国内行程中免费托运第一件行李
